title: Spherization of the velocity field of cosmological perturbations near density extrema
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学以空间均匀且各向同性的 FRW 度规为背景，把结构形成处理为背景膨胀上的小扰动。在线性近似下，物质密度扰动用密度反差 $\delta=\delta\rho/\bar{\rho}$ 描述，速度扰动用本动速度场 $\mathbf{v}(\mathbf{x},t)$ 描述；在非相对论物质主导时期，增长模的密度扰动与引力势 $\Phi$ 满足泊松方程，速度场与引力势梯度相联系，并随尺度因子增长。密度极值点（极大值或极小值）是原初晕、空洞等结构的自然种子；在其附近，一阶密度梯度为零，因此局部速度场和潮汐场由二阶导数及初始形状决定。研究这些极值点附近速度场的各向同性程度，是理解非线性坍缩初始条件、峰值统计和结构形成各向异性的重要基础。$z_{\mathrm{eq}}\simeq 3600$ 对应物质与辐射能量密度相等，之后宇宙进入非相对论物质主导阶段，引力不稳定性得以持续增长。
contribution: 本文在线性宇宙学扰动框架下考察一种使密度极值点（极大值或极小值）附近速度场趋于球对称的机制。结果表明，该机制从宇宙进入非相对论物质主导阶段（$z<z_{\mathrm{eq}}\simeq 3600$）起开始起作用，并能在较短时间内使密度极值附近的**速度分布几乎各向同性**；但若初始扰动的密度剖面明显非球对称，则其后续引力场会**破坏这种各向同性**。
summary: In this work, we consider a mechanism that tends to make the velocity field of linear cosmological perturbations near density extremum points (maxima or minima) spherically symmetric. It is shown that this mechanism begins to operate from the moment the Universe enters the stage of nonrelativistic matter domination ($z<z_{eq}\simeq 3600$) and rather quickly makes the velocity distribution near the density extremum practically isotropic. However, if the density profile of the initial perturbation is noticeably aspherical, its gravitational field subsequently destroys this isotropy.

title: Constraints on Reionization from Planck Low-$\ell$ EE Polarization and the Lyman-Series Forests
background_knowledge: 宇宙在复合之后经历黑暗时代；第一代恒星与星系释放的紫外光子逐渐把中性氢再电离，完成宇宙再电离。该过程通常用平均电离分数随红移的变化描述，并用再电离中点 $ z_{50} $、持续时间 $ \Delta z_{90} $、历史不对称度 $ A_z $ 以及 Thomson 散射光深 $ \tau_{\rm es} $ 等量刻画。CMB 的低多极矩 EE 极化对大尺度上由再电离电子产生的二次 Thomson 散射敏感，可约束 $ \tau_{\rm es} $，但不同电离历史可以给出相同积分光深，因而存在强简并。Lyman 系列森林则通过中性氢吸收探测 $ z\sim5-7 $ 的残余中性分数、暗隙与阻尼翼等特征，为再电离末期提供互补约束；结合两者可把总光深约束转化为对再电离时间与持续时间的约束。
contribution: 论文把 Lyman 系列森林对再电离结束的约束与完整 Planck 似然结合，检验森林数据能在多大程度上打破 $ \tau_{\rm es} $ 与再电离历史的简并。所用森林约束包括由暗像素比例给出的 $ 4.9\lesssim z\lesssim6.9 $ 中性分数上限，以及叠加森林光谱长暗隙边缘类阻尼翼特征在 $ z=5.8 $ 给出的下限。结果表明，**参数化与非参数化再电离模型的选择、以及不同森林数据组合，都不会显著改变 $ \tau_{\rm es} $ 或其他宇宙学参数；森林约束主要是在红移上重新分配 $ \tau_{\rm es} $**。联合暗像素、阻尼翼与 CMB 数据，得到再电离中点 $ z_{50}=7.7^{+0.7}_{-0.8} $，并给出持续时间 $ \Delta z_{90}<11.4 $ 的 95% 上限；历史不对称度 $ A_z $ 仍未受到良好约束。若进一步使用 Ly$\alpha$ 森林对 IGM 平均光致电离率的测量，可获得更强约束，但需要更细致的建模：采用新的半解析再电离模型得到（依赖模型的）$ z_{50}=7.4^{+0.2}_{-0.3} $、$ \Delta z_{90}=6.0^{+0.8}_{-1.0} $ 和 $ A_z=2.4^{+0.3}_{-0.7} $。论文还发现，**再电离源的电离发射率在 $ z=7-8 $ 之后下降**，这可能反映逃逸分数降低和/或反馈过程开始；这些结果推动发展森林似然产品以及透射统计的快速前向模型。
summary: CMB measurements tightly constrain the Thomson scattering optical depth ($τ_{\rm es}$), but they still permit a broad range of degenerate reionization histories. Incorporating Lyman-series forest constraints on the end of reionization can alleviate the degeneracy and narrow the range of allowed histories. We explore this effect using forest measurements combined with full Planck likelihoods. We apply upper limits on the neutral fraction at $4.9\lesssim z\lesssim6.9$ derived from the dark pixel fraction, as well as a lower limit at $z=5.8$ from damping-wing-like features on the edges of long dark gaps in stacked forest spectra. We find that neither the choice of parametric vs. non-parametric reionization model, nor the choice among different forest data combinations, produces a significant shift in $τ_{\rm es}$ or the other cosmological parameters. Instead, forest constraints primarily redistribute $τ_{\rm es}$ in redshift. Combining dark pixel, damping-wing-like, and CMB measurements, we find $z_{50}=7.7^{+0.7}_{-0.8}$ and a 95\% upper limit of $Δz_{90}<11.4$ for the midpoint and duration of reionization, respectively. The asymmetry of the reionization history ($A_z$) is not well constrained by these data. Stronger constraints can be obtained using Ly$α$ forest measurements of the mean IGM photoionization rate, at the cost of requiring more detailed modeling. Using a new semi-analytic reionization model, we obtain (model-dependent) constraints of $z_{50} = 7.4^{+0.2}_{-0.3}$, $Δz_{90}=6.0^{+0.8}_{-1.0}$, and $A_z = 2.4^{+0.3}_{-0.7}$. We also find evidence that the ionizing emissivity of reionization sources declines after $z=7-8$, perhaps signaling a decline in the escape fraction and/or the onset of a feedback process. Our results motivate the development of forest likelihood products and fast forward models for its transmission statistics.

title: The MIni-Halos in MIni-Clusters (MIMIC) project: New insights into the origin of mini-halos from a LOFAR, uGMRT, and MeerKAT study of diffuse radio emission in Abell 496 and ZwCl 235
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中由暗物质主导、包含大量高温团内介质（ICM）与星系的巨型引力束缚系统。ICM 在 X 射线波段发出热轫致辐射，其形态和温度结构可揭示冷却核、冷却流以及晃动（sloshing）产生的冷锋等动力学特征。射电迷你晕是出现在部分星系团中心、空间尺度约几十至几百 kpc 的弥散射电同步辐射源，通常与冷核和中心射电星系共存。其相对论电子可能来源于中心射电星系喷流遗留的化石等离子体，也可能由 ICM 湍流再加速，或两者共同作用。研究范式包括测量射电谱指数及其空间分布、比较射电与 X 射线表面亮度、检验 $P_{1.4}$ 与 $L_X$ 等标度关系，并利用低频射电观测约束电子能谱和再加速机制。低质量、低射电功率星系团中的迷你晕样本稀少，是检验上述模型的关键区域。
contribution: MIMIC 项目试点研究利用 LOFAR（54、144 MHz）、uGMRT（400、650 MHz）、MeerKAT（1.28 GHz）以及 Chandra X 射线数据，考察低质量（$M_{500}\leq3\times10^{14} M_{\odot}$）弛豫星系团 Abell 496 与 ZwCl 235 中的弥散射电辐射。作者在两个星系团中心约 100 kpc 内探测到弥散射电源，且其空间分布局限于 X 射线图像中晃动诱导的冷锋以内；这些源满足射电迷你晕分类标准，并是**迄今已知射电功率最低的迷你晕**，1.4 GHz 射电功率分别为 $(2.2\pm0.2)\times10^{22}$ W/Hz 和 $(1.3\pm0.3)\times10^{22}$ W/Hz。迷你晕具有较陡能谱（$-1.9\leq\alpha\leq-1.4$），且在 Abell 496 中发现谱指数向外变陡。两个星系团中，射电与 X 射线表面亮度在弥散源范围内均相关，相关斜率随频率呈亚线性或近线性。论文还给出了两个星系团中延展（>200 kpc）尾状射电星系的性质。陡谱、亚线性射电–X 射线相关以及冷锋内的空间限制表明，**中心射电星系输运出的化石等离子体贡献与可能的湍流再加速共同作用**。这些系统将迷你晕标度关系扩展到低功率区间，**确认迷你晕射电功率与冷核 X 射线光度强相关**，并给出 $P_{1.4} \propto L_{X,70}^{1.5\pm0.2}$。作者还**首次得到 tentative 迹象：射电谱更陡的迷你晕可能优先出现在冷核 X 射线光度较低、射电功率较低的系统之中**。
summary: We aim at investigating the presence of diffuse radio emission in low-mass (M$_{500}\leq3\times10^{14}$ M$_{\odot}$), relaxed galaxy clusters. We present a pilot study for the MIMIC (MIni-halos in MIni-Clusters) project, focusing on Abell 496 and ZwCl 235, using LOFAR (54, 144 MHz), uGMRT (400, 650 MHz), and MeerKAT (1.28 GHz) data, as well as Chandra X-ray data. We detect diffuse radio emission in the central 100 kpc of both Abell 496 and ZwCl 235, spatially confined within sloshing-induced cold fronts seen in X-ray images. The diffuse sources satisfy the classification criteria for radio mini-halos and represent the least powerful known to date, with 1.4 GHz radio powers of $(2.2\pm0.2)\times10^{22}$ W/Hz in Abell 496 and $(1.3\pm0.3)\times10^{22}$ W/Hz in ZwCl 235. The mini-halos have steep spectra ($-1.9\leqα\leq-1.4$), and in Abell 496 we find outward steepening of the spectral index. In both clusters, the radio and X-ray surface brightness are correlated over the diffuse source extent, with sub-linear or nearly linear slopes depending on frequency. Separately, we present the properties of two extended (>200 kpc) tailed radio galaxies in both clusters. The steep spectra, sub-linear radio-X-ray correlations, and confinement within cold fronts suggest that contribution from fossil plasma advected from the central radio galaxy and plausible turbulent re-acceleration are at play in Abell 496 and ZwCl 235. These two systems allow us to extend mini-halo scaling relations toward the low-power regime. We confirm a strong correlation between the mini-halo radio power and the cool core X-ray luminosity, with $P_{1.4} \propto L_{X,70}^{1.5\pm0.2}$. We find, for the first time, tentative indications that mini-halos with steeper radio spectra may preferentially be associated with lower core X-ray luminosities and lower radio power. (abridged)

title: Systematic Uncertainties in Rocky Exoplanet Reflected Light from Incomplete Laboratory BRDF Measurements
background_knowledge: 系外行星反射光表征是研究岩石行星表面与大气性质的重要途径。对于短周期岩石系外行星，望远镜接收到的反射光携带了表面反照率、散射相函数、大气成分与云霾等信息；但其解释依赖正向模型与反演框架，需要准确描述入射与观测几何下的双向反射分布函数（BRDF）。当前多数行星类比材料的光谱库只在单一照明与观测几何下测量，能够约束光谱形状，却难以完整约束角度散射性质。未来直接成像任务（如 HWO）将在可见光至近红外波段测量盘积分相位曲线、几何反照率和行星-恒星对比度，因此实验室 BRDF 的角度覆盖会直接影响对岩石系外行星的可观测预言与物理参数反演。
contribution: 论文指出，**不完整的实验室 BRDF 角覆盖会在岩石系外行星反射光解释中引入本征系统不确定度**。作者证明，**多组 photometric parameters 可以复现同一实验室反射光谱，却预测不同的角度散射行为与盘积分可观测量**。作者将这种非唯一性传播到 $0.5$--$1.7\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ 波段的反射光相位曲线、几何反照率与行星-恒星对比度，该波段对应 HWO 等未来直接成像任务的目标范围。结果显示，**单几何实验室光谱会在预测信号中产生较大不确定度，尤其在小相位角处**；**各向同性散射等简化假设还会额外引入系统偏差**。利用 Bloomsburg University Goniometer 数据集的多角度实验室测量，作者进一步表明，**一旦直接约束角度散射行为，预测可观测量的不确定度就会显著收缩**。因此，**构建具有物理预测能力的岩石系外行星反射光模型需要多角度测量**。
summary: The first observations of short-period rocky exoplanets have initiated the era of terrestrial exoplanet characterization. The interpretation of these observations relies on forward models used in atmospheric and surface retrieval frameworks. While atmospheric modeling is supported by extensive laboratory datasets of molecular opacities, the experimental basis for rocky surface characterization remains limited. Most reflectance libraries of planetary analog materials provide spectra measured at a single illumination and viewing geometry, constraining the spectral behavior but not its full angular scattering properties. We show that incomplete angular coverage in laboratory bidirectional reflectance measurements introduces an intrinsic systematic uncertainty in the interpretation of rocky exoplanet observations. We demonstrate that multiple combinations of photometric parameters can reproduce the same laboratory reflectance spectrum while predicting different angular scattering behaviors and disk-integrated observables. We propagate this non-uniqueness to reflected-light phase curves, geometric albedos, and planet-star contrast ratios between $0.5$--$1.7\,μ$m, representative of the spectral range targeted by future direct-imaging missions such as the HWO. We find that single-geometry laboratory spectra produce large uncertainties in predicted signals, particularly at small phase angles. Simplified assumptions adopted in exoplanet studies, such as isotropic scattering can additionally introduce systematic biases. Using multi-angular laboratory measurements from the Bloomsburg University Goniometer dataset, we show that the uncertainty in predicted observables collapses once angular scattering behavior is directly constrained. Our results demonstrate that multi-angular measurements are required to construct physically predictive reflected-light models of rocky exoplanets.

title: Unveiling the correlation between the UV 2175 Å dust attenuation bump, PAH emission, and gas-phase metallicity at cosmic noon
background_knowledge: 星系演化研究依赖把多波段观测到的星光、尘埃吸收与再辐射解释为恒星形成、尘埃和金属丰度的综合结果。尘埃会吸收和散射紫外—光学光，使星系光谱按“衰减曲线”变暗；银河系及部分星系在静止系约 2175 Å 处呈现宽吸收鼓包，其载体仍未完全确定，多环芳烃（PAH）分子是主要候选之一。PAH 在富金属、尘埃遮蔽较强的环境中更易存在，在强辐射场中会被破坏，因此其丰度与金属丰度、恒星形成强度、尘埃几何和光学深度相关。宇宙正午（红移 $1.5 < z < 2.7$）是星系恒星形成和尘埃增生的活跃时期，研究该时期的衰减鼓包有助于连接尘埃颗粒性质与星系演化。观测上通常由光谱测量鼓包幅度，用多波段测光进行 SED 拟合得到 PAH 与尘埃质量比，并用强发射线诊断气相氧丰度；随后通过相关分析和主成分分析检验质量、SFR、金属丰度与尘埃几何的相对作用。
contribution: 本文首次对宇宙正午 $1.5 < z < 2.7$ 的 49 个星系开展 UV 2175 Å 衰减鼓包与 PAH 丰度的系统研究，并在其中 19 个星系中利用氧丰度考察气相金属丰度。作者用 VLT/MUSE 光谱测量鼓包幅度 $E_{\rm bump}$，结合 JWST/NIRCam 与 JWST/MIRI 测光，通过 Prospector 的 SED 拟合得到包括 PAH 与尘埃质量比 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 在内的星系性质；氧丰度则由 Keck/MOSFIRE 和 JWST/NIRSpec 数据的强线诊断给出。核心结果是：$E_{\rm bump}$ 与 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 呈正相关（Spearman $\rho = 0.60$），且在低 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 时很少探测到 UV 鼓包，**这支持 PAH 是 UV 鼓包的主要载体**。$E_{\rm bump}$ 和 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 均与恒星质量、氧丰度和光学深度正相关，与比恒星形成率反相关，说明**PAH 与 UV 鼓包在低金属丰度、贫尘埃和/或强恒星形成环境中受到抑制**，与有限尘埃遮蔽和/或强辐射场导致 PAH 破坏的图像一致。对 $E_{\rm bump}$、$q_{\rm PAH}$、光学深度、比恒星形成率和氧丰度的主成分分析解释了 97% 的方差，提示**此前报告的与恒星质量的相关性可能反映了对金属丰度的潜在依赖**。最后，在高 $q_{\rm PAH}$ 下鼓包幅度的宽分布（$0$–$0.5\ \mathrm{mag}$）可能由尘埃几何差异解释。
summary: The UV 2175 Å attenuation bump is one of the most prominent yet poorly understood features of galaxy attenuation curves. Its main candidate carrier is polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) molecules, which are more prevalent in high-metallicity environments. We present the first systematic study of the relationship between PAH abundance and the UV bump in 49 galaxies at cosmic noon (1.5 < z < 2.7), examining its dependence on stellar mass, star formation rate (SFR), and V-band optical depth. For 19 galaxies, we also investigate gas-phase metallicity using oxygen abundances. We measure the bump amplitude from VLT/MUSE spectroscopy and derive galaxy properties, including the PAH-to-dust mass fraction $q_{\rm PAH}$, through spectral energy distribution fitting with Prospector, combining JWST/NIRCam and JWST/MIRI photometry. Oxygen abundances are derived from strong-line diagnostics using Keck/MOSFIRE and JWST/NIRSpec data. We find a positive correlation between bump amplitude $E_{\rm bump}$ and $q_{\rm PAH}$ (Spearman $ρ= 0.60$). UV bumps are rarely detected at low $q_{\rm PAH}$, supporting PAHs as their primary carriers. Both $E_{\rm bump}$ and $q_{\rm PAH}$ correlate with stellar mass, oxygen abundance, and optical depth, and anticorrelate with specific SFR, suggesting that PAHs and the UV bump are suppressed in low-metallicity, dust-poor, and/or intensely star-forming environments. This is consistent with PAH destruction in environments with limited dust shielding and/or strong radiation fields. A principal component analysis of $E_{\rm bump}$, $q_{\rm PAH}$, optical depth, specific SFR, and oxygen abundance explains 97% of the variance, suggesting that previously reported correlations with stellar mass reflect an underlying dependence on metallicity. Finally, variations in dust geometry may explain the wide range of bump amplitudes (0-0.5 mag) at high $q_{\rm PAH}$.

title: Prior volume effect inflates the gravitational-wave background in pulsar timing arrays
background_knowledge: 纳赫兹引力波的波长可达数光年，无法用地面激光干涉仪直接探测，因此主要依赖脉冲星计时阵列（Pulsar Timing Array，PTA）。其基本思路是把银河系中一批毫秒脉冲星当作极其稳定的宇宙时钟，长期监测脉冲到达时间并构造计时残差。若存在随机引力波背景（stochastic gravitational-wave background，GWB），它会在不同脉冲星残差中留下具有特定角相关的公共信号，其中 Hellings-Downs（HD）角相关是关键的判别特征。GWB 的主要候选源是超大质量黑洞双星（supermassive black hole binary，SMBHB）并合。PTA 数据分析通常采用贝叶斯推断，同时建模每个脉冲星的内禀红噪声、计时模型误差和公共 GWB。难点在于单脉冲星自相关对 GWB 与内禀红噪声高度退化，而 HD 互相关虽能单独指示 GWB，却常因数据量和脉冲星数目有限而较弱。当似然函数对某些参数约束不强时，边缘化会对先验体积敏感，可能使后验峰值偏离最大似然估计；剖面似然、仅用互相关的估计量以及不同先验形式可用于检验这类先验体积效应。
contribution: 基于 NANOGrav 15 年数据，作者表明 PTA 所报道的 GWB 振幅超出多数 SMBHB 预言的部分，**有相当比例来自先验体积效应**。GWB 振幅主要由脉冲星自相关约束，而 GWB 与每个脉冲星的内禀红噪声退化；分解 GWB 后验后发现，对标准对数均匀红噪声先验做边缘化会引入偏爱更强 GWB 的先验体积项，把推断振幅拉到**比最大似然估计高逾 $2\sigma$**。HD 互相关虽能单独测量 GWB，但强度不足以抵消该体积项。剖面似然、仅用互相关的估计量，以及在功率上均匀或由脉冲星族群信息构造的先验，均可避免或减弱该效应，并将振幅**降至与 SMBHB 预言相符**。修正先验还给出**更陡、更接近 SMBHB 预言的 GWB 谱**，**增强 HD 相关证据**，并**削弱相对 SMBHB 而言对新物理源的偏好**。
summary: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) have found evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background (GWB) whose amplitude exceeds most predictions based on supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs). Using NANOGrav 15-year data, we show that a substantial part of this excess arises from a prior volume effect. The GWB amplitude is constrained mainly by the pulsars' auto-correlations, where the GWB is degenerate with each pulsar's intrinsic red noise. By decomposing the GWB posterior, we find that marginalizing over the standard log-uniform red-noise priors introduces a prior volume term that favors a stronger GWB, pulling the inferred amplitude more than $2σ$ above the maximum-likelihood estimate. The Hellings-Downs (HD) cross-correlations, which measure the GWB alone, are not strong enough to counter the volume term. The profile likelihood, a cross-correlation-only estimator, and priors that are uniform in power or informed by the pulsar population all avoid or reduce this effect and lower the amplitude into agreement with SMBHBs. The revised priors also yield a steeper GWB spectrum closer to the SMBHB predictions, strengthen the evidence for HD correlations, and weaken the preference for new-physics sources over SMBHBs.

title: Solar System Surface Technosignatures: Searching for Signs of Artificial Design on Extraterrestrial Terrain
background_knowledge: 技术特征（technosignature）指可观测的、可能由地外技术活动产生的现象。传统搜寻以射电信号为主，也涵盖光学激光、热辐射和工业污染等。表面技术特征把搜寻对象扩展到行星地表的非随机、具有目的性或设计性的图案与结构，例如几何布局、重复单元、道路或开采痕迹、巨型纪念碑等。其研究方法结合行星遥感与考古学：先在高分辨率影像中识别低概率自然形成的异常，再用多波段、多模态数据排除地质成因。月球与火星缺乏板块运动、流水风化和生物扰动，地表痕迹可保存极长时间；但陨石撞击、尘暴、斜坡过程和火山活动仍会造成改造与假阳性。现代遥感可提供亚米级至米级影像，机器学习能够处理海量数据；异常检测可分为有监督（利用已知正样本）与无监督（仅建模自然背景）两类。LiDAR、探地雷达和反射光谱可提供地形、地下结构与物质成分信息，用于后续验证。即使未探测到目标，也可把结果转化为对地表技术结构密度或尺度的统计上限。
contribution: 论文把人类学视角引入技术特征搜寻，提出应系统搜寻“表面技术特征”：行星地表上非随机、具有意图或设计痕迹的图案与结构，类比地球上持久的人造景观与纪念碑。作者指出，在月球和火星这类地质不活跃天体上，人工痕迹可能在数亿年尺度上仍可辨认。文章强调两项进展使该方向正当其时：一是火星勘测轨道飞行器（MRO）上 HiRISE 等设备提供的高分辨率影像数据，二是基于机器学习（ML）的异常检测方法。随后，作者给出发展搜寻模型的两条可能路线，即**有监督方法与无监督方法**；并指出与 LiDAR、探地雷达及反射光谱联合使用，可在**首次对表面技术特征给出定量上限**的同时，为行星科学带来附带收益。摘要未报告实际探测结果。
summary: Artificial radio emissions have historically been a major focus of technosignature searches. Here, we apply an anthropological lens to expand this scope to surface technosignatures: non-random, intentional patterning on planetary terrain, similar to long-lasting human-made landscapes and monuments on Earth. On geologically inactive bodies such as the Moon and Mars, artificial traces and patterns could potentially remain visible for hundreds of millions of years. We discuss two recent developments that make this search timely: high-resolution imaging datasets, such as those produced by the HiRISE camera on the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO), and ML-based anomaly-detection methods. Finally, we list two possible approaches to developing a model capable of searching for these surface technosignatures: a supervised and an unsupervised one. Complemented by LiDAR, ground-penetrating radar, and reflectance spectroscopy, these methods would enable the first quantitative upper limits on surface technosignatures while yielding ancillary benefits for planetary science.

title: Not so Fast: Revised Calibration of SIDM Core Collapse
background_knowledge: 暗物质约占宇宙物质总量的 85%，其引力作用是星系、星系团和大尺度结构形成的基础。标准冷暗物质（CDM）模型假设暗物质粒子仅通过引力相互作用，但在小尺度上仍存在若干待检验问题。自相互作用暗物质（SIDM）进一步假设暗物质粒子之间存在非引力弹性散射，这种散射可在晕内部输运热量，驱动所谓的引力热演化：内区通过向外传热而收缩、升温，最终可能发生失控的核心坍缩。该过程受粒子平均自由程控制，需在长平均自由程（LMFP）与短平均自由程（SMFP）两种热导率区间之间进行合理衔接，因而高度依赖数值标定。核心坍缩会显著改变致密子结构、暗物质湮灭信号以及黑洞种子形成的预言；但传统 N-body 模拟受引力软化限制，难以追踪极深的核心密度，而一维引力热流体模型又需要可靠的校准。
contribution: 本文使用新的球形直接模拟蒙特卡洛代码 SphDSMC 重新校准 SIDM 晕的引力热演化。该代码求解球对称 SIDM 系统，不引入引力软化，并能追踪到远高于常规 N-body 模拟的中心密度。作者将 SphDSMC 与 N-body 模拟及一维引力热流体模型对比，发现 **N-body 结果只有在软化长度显著小于无碰撞模拟常用取值时才收敛到 SphDSMC**；同时，只要实现得当，每个粒子每时间步允许多次散射不会带来显著误差。校准流体方程后，作者指出 **常用的 LMFP 与 SMFP 热导率调和插值并不准确**，而更平缓的过渡形式配合单一 LMFP 热导率参数，可在多种浓度和截断半径下很好地描述 NFW 晕。修订后的标定给出 **略短于先前估计的 LMFP 坍缩时间**，但进一步表明 **核心变为光学厚后坍缩会显著变慢**。论文还提供了晚期演化的拟合函数，并认为 **SIDM 引力热坍缩形成黑洞种子所需的持续时间此前被普遍低估，因此若无额外物理，该机制难以解释 JWST 观测到的高红移大质量黑洞**。
summary: Self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) haloes undergo gravothermal evolution whose late-time behaviour is central to predictions for dense substructure and black-hole seed formation. We revisit the calibration of this evolution using a new spherical Direct Simulation Monte Carlo code, SphDSMC, which follows spherically symmetric SIDM systems without force softening and to substantially higher central densities than standard N-body simulations. We compare SphDSMC calculations with conventional N-body simulations and with one-dimensional gravothermal fluid models. We show that N-body results converge to SphDSMC only for softening lengths significantly smaller than those normally adopted for collisionless simulations, and that allowing multiple scatterings per particle per time step does not introduce significant errors when implemented appropriately. Calibrating the gravothermal fluid equations against SphDSMC, we find that the commonly used harmonic interpolation between the long- and short-mean-free-path conductivities is inaccurate. A gentler transition, however, yields excellent agreement for NFW haloes over a range of concentrations and truncation radii, with a single long-mean-free-path conductivity parameter. The revised calibration gives a long-mean-free-path collapse time that is somewhat shorter than previous estimates, but we show that collapse slows dramatically once the core becomes optically thick. We provide fitting functions for the late-time evolution and argue that black-hole seed formation by SIDM gravothermal collapse has generally been underestimated in duration, making it unlikely to explain the massive high-redshift black holes inferred from JWST observations without additional physics.

title: Orientation-dependent sensitivity of the all-sky all-frequency gravitational-wave radiometer search to continuous-wave sources
background_knowledge:
引力波是时空曲率的传播性扰动，地面激光干涉仪（LIGO、Virgo、KAGRA）通过测量两条长臂之间微小的长度变化来探测它。按照信号形态，引力波搜索大致分为三类：致密双星并合产生的短时瞬变信号、宇宙早期或大量未分辨源叠加形成的随机引力波背景，以及来自持续旋转的非轴对称中子星等天体的连续波（CW）信号。连续波信号近似单色，但其频率、相位演化、天空位置和偏振状态往往未知或建模困难，因此除匹配滤波外，还常用“radiometer（辐射计）”这类统计量：将两个探测器的数据交叉关联，对全天区和全频段进行扫描，以寻找共同的微弱信号。
\n在随机背景搜索中，若背景是非偏振的，则对 $+$ 和 $\times$ 两种张量偏振等权处理是最优的。然而连续波源的偏振由源的倾角 $\iota$ 和偏振角 $\psi$ 决定，一般并非非偏振。斜视观测时，探测到的功率会低于同样内禀振幅的正面源，形成投影因子 $\mu^2(\iota,\psi)$。这一几何投影效应会直接影响搜索灵敏度、信号信噪比以及上限的物理解释。
\n该方向的研究范式通常包括：构建统计量与信号模型，推导其对源参数（天空位置、偏振、频率、振幅）的依赖；利用模拟注入检验探测效率；在真实观测数据上给出贝叶斯上限或候选事件显著性。由于连续波尚未被直接探测，理解搜索对不同源方向的敏感性差异，对于从上限结果反推中子星椭率、距离和倾角分布等天体物理约束至关重要。
contribution:
论文研究全天全频（ASAF）引力波辐射计搜索对连续波源的**方向依赖敏感性**。ASAF 统计量对 $+$ 与 $\times$ 张量偏振等权交叉关联两个探测器的数据，这对非偏振随机背景最优，但对偏振依赖倾角 $\iota$ 和偏振角 $\psi$ 的连续波源并非最优；斜视源会被测到低于其内禀强度的功率。
\n作者展示了投影因子 $\mu^2(\iota,\psi)$ 如何进入 ASAF 统计量，推导了其对 $\psi$ 的精确依赖，并证明**对所有方向取平均后 $\mu^2$ 恰为 $2/5$，且与天区位置、基线几何、噪声加权和频率无关**。
\n随后将形式应用于四个模拟脉冲星信号（偏振从圆偏振到近线偏振），注入第二代观测运行（O2）期间的 LIGO 探测器。一个近侧向注入的信号测得信噪比（SNR）为 $5.20$，低于阈值 $6.19$；而同一信号若正面观测，SNR 可达 $31.1 \pm 6.0$。对应变振幅 $h_0$ 的贝叶斯上限（边缘化方向和校准不确定度）为正面情形上限的 **$2.7$ 至 $2.9$ 倍**。
\n对于第四轮 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 观测运行前半段（O4a）的 $505$ 个亚阈值候选，上限增加 **$2.5$ 至 $2.9$ 倍**；同强度源只有在偏离正面小于 **$34.7^{\circ}$ 至 $50.3^{\circ}$** 时才能达到阈值。所有候选的实测 SNR 和显著性均保持不变。
summary: The all-sky all-frequency (ASAF) gravitational-wave radiometer search cross-correlates the data of two detectors with equal weight on the $+$ and $\times$ tensor polarizations. This is optimal for an unpolarized stochastic background, but not for continuous-wave (CW) sources, whose polarization depends on the inclination angle $ι$ and the polarization angle $ψ$. Unless the source is seen face-on, the search measures less power than a face-on source with the same intrinsic amplitude, and underestimates its strength. The ratio of the two powers, the projection factor $μ^2(ι,ψ)$, is known from earlier radiometer studies. We show how $μ^2$ enters the ASAF statistic, derive its exact dependence on $ψ$, and prove that its average over orientations is exactly $2/5$, independent of sky position, baseline geometry, noise weighting, and frequency. We apply the formalism to four simulated pulsar signals at four sky positions, with polarization from circular to nearly linear, injected into the LIGO detectors during the second observing run (O2). A nearly edge-on injection is measured with a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of $5.20$, below the threshold of $6.19$, while the same signal seen face-on would have an SNR of $31.1 \pm 6.0$. Bayesian upper limits on the strain amplitude $h_0$, marginalized over orientation and calibration uncertainty, are $2.7$ to $2.9$ times the face-on values. For the $505$ sub-threshold candidates of the first part of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run (O4a), the upper limits increase by a factor of $2.5$ to $2.9$, and a source of the same strength would reach threshold only when inclined by less than $34.7^{\circ}$ to $50.3^{\circ}$ from face-on. The measured SNR and the significance of every candidate are unchanged.

title: Ballistic mixing: stellar mergers drive internal mixing in extremely massive stars, with implications for proto-globular cluster pollution
background_knowledge: 球状星团是古老、致密的恒星系统，其恒星多星族现象表现为轻元素丰度的反相关，例如 Na–O、Mg–Al 等。解释这一现象通常需要第一代恒星在短时间内完成核合成，并把特殊化学指纹注入星团内气体，供第二代恒星形成。极端大质量恒星（EMS）质量可达 $10^3$–$10^4\,M_\odot$，在早期主序阶段中心温度可达 65 至 75 MK，可通过 CNO、NeNa、MgAl 循环产生与观测相符的丰度异常，因此被视为潜在的化学污染源。此类恒星在致密星团中可由多次恒星碰撞与合并形成；研究难点在于同时处理 $N$ 体动力学、三维碰撞中的激波加热与湍流混合，以及长期恒星演化。常用研究范式是用 $N$ 体模拟给出合并历史，用一维恒星模型演化合并产物，并以三维流体模拟标定混合与加热方案。
contribution: 论文基于与红移 $z\sim10$ 处最致密观测星团相似的直接 $N$ 体星团模拟，追踪一颗约 $6700\,M_\odot$ 的恒星经由 253 次恒星合并形成；论文对每次合并后的恒星用一维恒星模型演化，并采用由三维抛物碰撞模拟标定的混合与激波加热方案构造合并产物。研究发现，**基于熵的混合能高效地把对流核中经核反应处理的物质输运到包层，而合并驱动的加热进一步促进化学均匀化**；最终**恒星表面富集氢燃烧产物，形成与球状星团多星族观测一致的丰度模式**。这些结果**支持由合并形成的极端大质量恒星作为原球状星团类似环境中早期化学富集的潜在来源**。
summary: Extremely massive stars, with masses of $10^3$-$10^4$ M$_\odot$, have been proposed as potential sources of the chemical enrichment associated with multiple populations in globular clusters. Early on the main sequence, these stars reach central temperatures of 65 to 75 MK, enabling nucleosynthesis through the CNO, NeNa, and MgAl cycles, producing abundance patterns similar to those observed in the so-called cluster's second population. Stellar mergers are among the leading formation channels for extremely massive stars. In this work, we follow the formation of a $\sim6700$ M$_\odot$ star via 253 stellar mergers, drawn from a direct $N$-body star cluster simulation with properties similar to the densest star clusters observed at redshift $z\sim10$. We evolve each star as a 1D stellar model and construct the merger products from mixing and shock heating prescriptions calibrated to 3D simulations of parabolic collisions. We find that entropy-based mixing efficiently transports nuclear-processed material from the convective core to the envelope, while merger-driven heating promotes chemical homogenization. As a result, the stellar surface becomes enriched with H-burning products, producing abundance patterns consistent with those observed in globular cluster multiple populations and supporting the role of merger-formed extremely massive stars as potential sources of early chemical enrichment in proto-globular cluster-like conditions.

title: SpinOctopus: A Versatile, User-Friendly, and Extensible Public Code for General-Relativistic Ray-Tracing in axisymmetric spacetime
background_knowledge:
广义相对论光线追踪是研究强引力场中电磁辐射传播的核心数值手段。其基本物理图像是：在弯曲时空中，光子沿零测地线运动，测地线方程可写为 $\frac{d^{2}x^{\mu}}{d\lambda^{2}}+\Gamma^{\mu}_{\alpha\beta}\frac{dx^{\alpha}}{d\lambda}\frac{dx^{\beta}}{d\lambda}=0$；观测者看到的图像通常由从相机逐像素反向积分光线、并沿途累积辐射与吸收得到。强引力会使吸积盘、喷流等辐射源产生多重像、光子环和黑洞阴影，这些特征携带有黑洞质量、自旋、时空度规以及吸积物理的信息。
\n该领域的研究范式通常是：给定时空度规和光源模型，求解零测地线并进行辐射转移，生成图像、光变曲线或谱线轮廓，再与电磁观测比较，以检验引力理论并理解高能天体物理过程。轴对称时空涵盖 Kerr 黑洞、Kerr-Newman 黑洞以及多种修改引力或参数化度规；不同度规预言的黑洞阴影形状、光子环结构和轨道动力学可能不同。数值实现需要处理测地线积分、步长控制、光源几何、辐射转移和并行计算等环节，因而通用、可扩展且高效的光线追踪代码是该方向的重要基础设施。
contribution:
论文开发并公开发布了 SpinOctopus，一套面向任意轴对称时空的通用广义相对论光线追踪代码，采用 Fortran/Python 混合架构和 OpenMP 多线程加速。**该代码能够统一模拟类时轨道及其对应光变曲线、零测地线，以及由几何薄/厚吸积盘、几何薄倾斜盘、相对论喷流、球对称吸积流和点源等多种现象学光源照亮的黑洞图像。** 用户只需在专用配置文件中指定目标时空的协变度规张量 $g_{\mu\nu}$ 和模拟参数，即可开展计算；代码还提供透明接口，便于用户修改光源的几何与运动学性质。
\n得益于为测地线积分定制的自适应步长策略，**SpinOctopus 在模拟几何厚吸积盘图像时，于 Intel Core i7-14700 平台上达到约 800 条光线/秒/线程的处理效率**。未来版本还将加入 Fe K $\alpha$ 荧光线轮廓和几何厚倾斜吸积盘图像等功能。
summary: Relativistic ray-tracing algorithms serve as indispensable numerical tools for investigating gravitational theories and high-energy astrophysics. In this paper, we develop and release SpinOctopus, a versatile relativistic ray-tracing code tailored for arbitrary axisymmetric spacetimes, powered by a Fortran/Python hybrid architecture and OpenMP multi-threading acceleration. This numerical toolkit is capable of simulating timelike orbits and their corresponding light curves, null geodesics, as well as black hole images illuminated by a wide array of phenomenological sources, including geometrically thin and thick accretion disks, geometrically thin tilted disks, relativistic jets, spherically symmetric accretion flows, and point sources. To execute these tasks, users are solely required to specify the covariant metric tensor of the target spacetime and the simulation parameters within a dedicated configuration file. Benefiting from our customized adaptive step-size strategy for geodesic integration, SpinOctopus achieves an impressive processing efficiency of $\sim 800$ rays per second per thread on an Intel Core i7-14700 platform when simulating geometrically thick accretion disk images. Furthermore, the code provides transparent interfaces, allowing users to seamlessly modify the geometric and kinematic properties of the light sources. Additional capabilities, such as simulating Fe K$α$ fluorescent line profiles and geometrically thick tilted accretion disk images, will be introduced in future releases of the framework.

title: On Particle Production from Bubble Collisions in the Non-runaway Regime
background_knowledge: 早期宇宙中的一阶相变（first-order phase transition, FOPT）通常涉及标量场从亚稳真空经气泡成核向真真空隧穿或热跃迁。气泡壁在真空能释放与等离子体摩擦的竞争下运动：若摩擦足够强，壁速度 $v_w$ 会显著小于光速，进入非 runaway 区域；反之，传统处理常近似为 $v_w \to 1$ 的 runaway 气泡。气泡碰撞、壁运动及相变后的场振荡可激发粒子，被视为重子生成和暗物质产生的可能机制之一。半经典层面，粒子产生可归结为随时间变化的背景场中的量子场激发，可由 Klein-Gordon 方程描述。为获得解析可控结果，文献中常采用薄壁、boosted kink 剖面、$SO(1,1)$ 对称性或 trapping equation 等近似；这些近似在非 runaway、有限壁厚及强摩擦场景中的适用性，是该方向的重要基础问题。
contribution: 论文将气泡碰撞产生粒子的处理从 runaway 极限推广到任意 $v_w<1$，以覆盖电弱重子生成及强壁摩擦等情形。作者首先把 trapping-equation 解析方法扩展到有限厚度的 boosted kink 剖面，并同时考虑弹性与非弹性碰撞；随后进一步放弃 $SO(1,1)$ 对称性和薄壁假设，在较宽的 $v_w$ 与势能形状参数网格上数值求解完整的 Klein-Gordon 方程。关键结果为：**在 $v_w$ 明显小于 1、远离 runaway 极限时，解析推广会低估真实效率因子达数个量级**；论文据此给出由幂律连续谱与共振峰组成的半解析拟合函数，可在所研究参数范围内重现数值结果的主要谱特征。将拟合应用于玩具暗扇区模型后，作者发现 **粒子产生随 $v_w$ 从 1 降低而强烈受抑，且对更轻的产生粒子更强；振荡峰对总产额的相对贡献也不同于以往 runaway 区域的估计**。论文最后讨论了 trapping equation 以及该形式体系所依赖的 off-shell effective-action 截断的局限性。
summary: Particle production from bubble collisions during First-Order Phase Transitions (FOPTs) has been studied as an efficient mechanism for baryogenesis and dark matter production, but existing semi-analytical treatments assume runaway bubbles with wall velocity $v_w\to 1$. We generalize this treatment to arbitrary $v_w< 1$, relevant for scenarios such as electroweak baryogenesis and transitions with significant wall friction. We first extend the analytical trapping-equation approach to finite-thickness boosted kink profiles for both elastic and inelastic collisions, then go beyond this by numerically solving the full Klein-Gordon equation without assuming $SO(1,1)$ symmetry or thin walls, across a broad grid of $v_w$ and potential shapes. We find the analytical generalization underestimates the true efficiency factor by orders of magnitude away from $v_w\to 1$, and provide new semi-analytic fit functions consisting of a power-law continuum plus a resonance peak, which reproduce the main spectral features of the numerical results across the parameter range studied. Applying these to a toy dark sector model, we show particle production is strongly suppressed as $v_w$ decreases from unity, enhanced for lighter produced particles, and that the relative contribution from the oscillatory peak differs from prior runaway-regime estimates. We also discuss limitations of the trapping equation and the off-shell effective-action truncation underlying this formalism.

title: In-orbit anomaly and recovery of IXPE detector 2
background_knowledge: X 射线偏振测量通过测定天体辐射的线偏振度与偏振角，探测 X 射线发射机制、磁场几何以及粒子加速环境。对于脉冲星、脉冲星风星云、超新星遗迹、活动星系核、磁星等源，偏振信息可区分同步辐射、热辐射与散射等过程，并约束辐射区磁场的有序程度。IXPE 采用三台相同的掠入射 X 射线望远镜，将 $2\text{--}8\ \mathrm{keV}$ 的 X 射线聚焦到基于 Gas Pixel Detector 的焦平面偏振仪上。其工作方式是：入射 X 射线在气体中发生光电吸收，产生光电子；光电子在气体中留下径迹，其初始方向与入射 X 射线的偏振方向相关。探测器像素阵列与专用 ASIC 读出电子学记录径迹图像，再通过事件级径迹重建得到偏振度和偏振角。该子领域依赖精细的仪器响应标定、在轨性能监测与背景建模；任何读出电子学异常都可能改变径迹重建和仪器响应，因此需要在轨诊断、修正与恢复策略。
contribution: IXPE 是 NASA 与 ASI 的联合任务，于 2021 年 12 月发射，在 $2\text{--}8\ \mathrm{keV}$ 能段测量天体 X 射线源的线偏振。载荷由三台相同望远镜组成，每台均将掠入射 X 射线光学系统与基于 Gas Pixel Detector 的焦平面光电偏振仪结合。**2025 年 4 月 14 日，第二台探测器发生异常，显著改变了负责读出光电子径迹图像的 ASIC 的电学行为。** 本文描述该异常对仪器响应的影响，并介绍为减轻其影响、恢复仪器科学观测所采取的措施。
summary: The Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE) is a joint NASA-ASI mission launched in December 2021 to measure the linear polarization of celestial X-ray sources in the 2-8 keV energy range. The payload comprises three identical telescopes, each combining grazing-incidence X-ray optics with a focal-plane photoelectric polarimeter based on the Gas Pixel Detector technology. On 14 April 2025, the second detector experienced an anomaly that significantly altered the electrical behavior of the ASIC responsible for reading out the photoelectron track images. In this contribution, we describe the effect of the anomaly on the instrumental response and the actions taken to mitigate its effects and recover the scientific observations of the instrument.

title: Ammonia Fitting of Multiple Velocity Components in High-Mass Star-Forming Regions
background_knowledge: 巨分子云（GMCs）是银河系冷、致密分子气体的主要储库，也是大质量恒星和星团形成的主要场所。其内部由湍流、磁场、引力塌缩与恒星反馈共同塑造，常呈现纤维状结构、致密核以及沿视线方向相互叠加的复杂速度场。氨（$\mathrm{NH_3}$）的射电反转跃迁是探测致密分子气体的重要手段：其亚稳态能级跃迁可示踪密度较高的气体，而 $(1,1)$、$(2,2)$ 等多条谱线可用于约束气体温度、速度与速度弥散。观测上，通常对谱线轮廓进行辐射转移或高斯成分拟合，以获得质心速度、线宽和温度等参数。若一条视线穿过多个云、纤维体或核，单成分拟合会把不同速度的气体混在一起，导致线宽被高估并扭曲运动学解释；因此，多速度成分分解是研究云内结构、湍流以及吸积/外流等相干运动的关键步骤。大质量恒星形成区往往位于致密、团簇化的环境中，其谱线常显示显著的速度结构，这也是该领域观测分析的核心难点之一。
contribution: 论文基于 Green Bank Telescope 的 KEYSTONE 巡天，对覆盖 11 个巨分子云（距离约 0.7 到 2.7 kpc）的氨（$\mathrm{NH_3}$）气体开展多速度成分分析。作者扩展已有程序，实现了对 $\mathrm{NH_3}$ $(1,1)$ 谱线最多三个速度成分的同时辐射转移拟合，并据此给出了这些云迄今最佳的质心速度和速度弥散图。**在整个巡天中，约 13% 的已探测并拟合 $\mathrm{NH_3}$ 发射像素需要多速度成分描述，且主要出现在巨分子云核心的星团区域**。**在这些多成分像素中，$\mathrm{NH_3}$ 线宽中位数下降为单成分等效测量的约 1/1.4（减小因子约 1.4），同时不同云之间存在显著差异**。多速度成分区域倾向于分布在巨分子云最致密的区域和大质量恒星形成地点，暗示存在多条纤维体、多个核或与大质量恒星形成相关的复杂速度场。区分这些速度特征将为未来在该类复杂环境中定量研究下落、外流等相干运动奠定基础。多成分数据产品已在 CADC 公开。
summary: We perform a multiple velocity component analysis of ammonia (NH$_3$) gas from KEYSTONE, a Green Bank Telescope survey covering 11 giant molecular clouds (GMCs) at distances from 0.7 to 2.7 kpc. We extend existing codes to enable simultaneous fitting of up to three velocity components in NH$_3$ (1,1) with radiative transfer. Using our multiple component fitting technique, we produce the best maps of the centroid velocity and velocity dispersion in these clouds to date. Over the entire survey, multiple velocity components were seen in 13% of pixels where we detect and fit NH$_3$ emission, primarily in clusters at the heart of the GMCs. In these multiple component pixels, the median measured NH$_3$ linewidth decreased by a factor of 1.4 compared to equivalent single-component measurements, but there are also significant cloud-to-cloud variations. Regions with multiple velocity components tend to be found in the densest zones of the GMCs and at the sites of high-mass star formation, indicative of multiple filaments, cores, or complex velocities associated with the formation of massive stars. Disentangling these velocity features will allow future quantitative analysis of coherent motions, such as infall and outflow, in these complex environments. The multi-component data products are available on the CADC.

title: HETDEX [OII] galaxies at $z \le 0.48$: Growth of structures from power spectrum multipoles
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构（Large-Scale Structure）研究物质密度扰动的统计性质及其在引力作用下的演化。早期宇宙的微小密度涨落在暴胀中被放大，随后在引力不稳定性驱动下增长，形成星系、星系团以及宇宙网。在线性近似下，密度扰动增长率可写成 $f(a)\simeq\Omega_{\mathrm m}(a)^{\gamma}$，其中 $\gamma$ 为增长指数；在广义相对论（GR）加平直 $\Lambda$CDM 模型中，$\gamma\simeq0.55$。测量 $\gamma$ 因而可用于检验引力理论、暗能量性质及可能的修改引力。星系红移巡天通过星系的三维分布测量功率谱 $P(k)$。星系本动速度会造成红移空间畸变（RSD），使成团模式呈各向异性，并可分解为单极矩、四极矩等多极矩；其中四极矩对增长率与星系偏置敏感。Alcock-Paczyński（AP）效应则源于观测中假设的宇宙学距离关系与真实宇宙学不一致，也会产生各向异性。联合建模功率谱多极矩，可以同时约束结构增长、星系偏置和几何参数。常用做法是以 $N$-body 模拟生成的星系或暗物质晕目录作为模板，将观测功率谱与模型比较，从而进行宇宙学参数推断。在此框架下，HETDEX 利用积分视场光谱观测大量 [O II] 发射线星系，在低红移获得大体积样本，为独立检验结构增长和宇宙学模型提供了机会。
contribution: 论文利用 HETDEX Public Data Release 1 中 [O II] 发射线星系的单极矩与四极矩功率谱，约束 $z\le0.48$ 的宇宙结构增长。作者采用基于 Mucho-Uchuu-1G $N$-body 模拟构建的模型解释功率谱；最佳拟合模型在 $k_{\mathrm{max}}=0.7~h~\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$ 范围内很好地重现观测功率谱，拟合优度检验表明 HETDEX [O II] 星系成团性与 Planck 平直 $\Lambda$CDM 宇宙学一致。论文进一步检验广义相对论对线性增长指数的预言 $\gamma\simeq0.55$：当 Alcock-Paczyński 参数固定为基准值时，得到 $\gamma=0.55\pm0.05$，与 GR 预言一致；当 AP 参数自由变化时，得到 $\gamma=0.60\pm0.07$，同时与 GR 预言及 Nguyen 等（2023）报道的增长受抑制结果相容。**这些结果确立了 HETDEX [O II] 星系作为有竞争力的、独立的低红移结构增长探针，并推动未来开展完整的宇宙学推断。**
summary: We use the monopole and quadrupole power spectra of [\ion{O}{2}]-emitting galaxies in the HETDEX Public Data Release 1 to constrain the growth of cosmic structures at $z\le0.48$. We interpret the power spectra using a simulation-based model built from the Mucho-Uchuu-1G $N$-body simulation. The best-fit model reproduces the observed power spectra remarkably well up to $k_\mathrm{max}=0.7~h~\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$, and goodness-of-fit tests confirm that the HETDEX [\ion{O}{2}] clustering is consistent with the \textit{Planck} flat $Λ$CDM cosmology. We test the general relativity (GR) prediction for the linear growth index, $γ\simeq 0.55$. When the Alcock-Paczyński parameters are held fixed at their fiducial values, we find consistency with the GR prediction, $γ=0.55\pm 0.05$. And, when the AP parameters are allowed to vary, $γ=0.60\pm 0.07$, which is consistent with both the GR prediction and the suppressed growth rate reported by \citet{Nguyen_2023}. These results establish HETDEX [\ion{O}{2}] galaxies as a competitive, independent low-redshift probe of the growth of structures and motivate future full cosmological inference.

title: $ν$Gundam: a unified framework for point-redshift and PDF-aware spatial correlation functions
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学中，星系被视为暗物质密度场的示踪物，其空间分布的二点统计量（如两点相关函数）是刻画大尺度结构、测量宇宙学参数和星系偏袒的重要工具。红移巡天中，观测红移同时包含宇宙膨胀和本动速度贡献，因此通常把星系对分离分解为投影分离 $r_\mathrm{p}$ 与视线方向分离 $\pi$，并测量 $\xi(r_\mathrm{p},\pi)$。投影相关函数 $w_\mathrm{p}(r_\mathrm{p})$ 通过对 $\pi$ 方向积分来压低红移空间畸变，从而近似恢复真实空间聚类。测光红移误差通常远大于光谱红移误差，且往往以概率密度函数（PDF）而非单一数值给出；若只使用点估计，星系会沿视线方向被散射，星系对从较小的 $\pi$ 被重新分配到较大的 $\pi$，导致小尺度聚类信号被稀释。严格的测光红移聚类分析需要在星系对计数层面传播完整的红移 PDF，并发展精确、压缩或随机采样等不同计算策略，同时明确积分深度等测量定义，以兼顾精度与计算效率。
contribution: 论文提出 **$\nu$Gundam**，一个在星系对计数层面传播径向红移 PDF、同时为精确、压缩和随机投影聚类计算提供统一接口的框架。代码实现四种模式：经验 PDF 精确积分、高斯混合压缩、蒙特卡洛（MC）采样和分位数压缩；所有模式都在分辨的（$r_\mathrm{p},\pi$）网格上累计星系对，并据此重建 $\xi(r_\mathrm{p},\pi)$ 与 $w_\mathrm{p}(r_\mathrm{p};\Pi)$。作者用 DESI 星系和 CosmoDC2 模拟星表进行验证，发现各 PDF 感知模式给出的视线方向重分配核几乎不可区分，而点测光红移估计会丢失概率性星系对信息。径向不确定性主要把聚类信号重分配到更大的 $\pi$，恢复真实投影所需的积分深度随星系对径向弥散增大。实际设置下，**MC 采样、分位数压缩和高斯混合压缩能以低于 5% 的分数均方根残差重现精确结果**。应用于 DESI Bright Galaxy Survey 样本时，**MC 采样在 $r_\mathrm{p}\gtrsim0.8\,h^{-1}\mathrm{Mpc}$ 处恢复光谱聚类的形状与相对振幅**，红星系和蓝星系所需的样本相关恢复深度分别约为 400 与 180 $h^{-1}\mathrm{Mpc}$。论文总结认为，**带红移 PDF 的投影聚类本质上是一个星系对重分配问题**；一致地传播 PDF 后可准确且高效地恢复信号，且积分深度依赖样本，应作为测量定义的一部分而非固定选择。
summary: Context. Photometric-redshift uncertainties redistribute galaxy pairs along the line of sight (LOS), diluting spatial clustering measurements. Propagating full redshift probability density functions (PDFs) through standard pair-count estimators remains computationally demanding. Aims. We present $ν$Gundam, a unified framework to propagate radial PDFs at the pair-count level while retaining a common interface for exact, compressed, and stochastic projected-clustering calculations. Methods. The code implements four modes: exact empirical-PDF integration, Gaussian-mixture compression, Monte Carlo (MC) sampling, and a quantile-compression method. All modes accumulate pair counts on a resolved ($r_\mathrm{p},π$) grid, from which $ξ(r_\mathrm{p},π)$ and $w_\mathrm{p}(r_\mathrm{p};Π)$ are reconstructed. We validate these with DESI galaxies and CosmoDC2 mocks. Results. The PDF-aware modes produce nearly indistinguishable LOS redistribution kernels, while point-photo-$z$ estimates discard probabilistic pair information. Radial uncertainty mainly redistributes the clustering signal to larger $π$; the depth required to recover the truth projection scales with the pairwise radial dispersion. For practical settings, MC, quantile, and Gaussian-mixture compression reproduce the exact result with fractional RMS residuals below 5%. Applied to DESI Bright Galaxy Survey samples, MC sampling recovers spectroscopic clustering shapes and relative amplitudes for $r_\mathrm{p}\gtrsim0.8\,h^{-1}\mathrm{Mpc}$ using sample-dependent recovery depths of ~400 and ~$180\,h^{-1}\mathrm{Mpc}$ for red and blue galaxies. Conclusions. Projected clustering with redshift PDFs is a pair-redistribution problem. When propagated consistently, the signal is recovered accurately and efficiently. The integration depth is sample dependent and should be part of the measurement definition rather than a fixed choice.

title: Cosmic Ray Observations using Coincident Scintillator and Radio Signals with the Beamforming Elevated Array for COsmic Neutrinos (BEACON)
background_knowledge: 超高能宇宙线与超高能中微子是高能天体物理的重要信使，其探测可追溯宇宙中最剧烈的粒子加速过程。原初粒子进入大气后会产生广延大气簇射（EAS），其中次级带电粒子在地磁场中分离和偏转，产生地磁辐射；在致密介质中还可产生 Askaryan 辐射。这些射电辐射在足够高能量下具有相位相干性，强度随能量增长，因而可用天线阵列在射电波段探测。BEACON 方案利用山顶相控阵天线在水平方向监测大范围天空，寻找掠地 tau 中微子产生的向上传播地磁辐射，工作频段为 30–80 MHz；同一物理机制也适用于宇宙线诱发的射电信号。相控阵与 beamforming 技术可提高触发灵敏度并压低背景，而闪烁体探测器可提供粒子层面的符合测量，用于交叉验证射电探测到的宇宙线。
contribution: BEACON 原型此前以四天线 beamforming 射电触发成功识别相干、脉冲式源；2023 年升级为六副新设计天线，并加入独立闪烁体阵列，以交叉验证射电可探测宇宙线。本文在闪烁体符合触发数据集中，依据预期射电特征进行筛选，**观测到 22 个候选宇宙线事件**。混合仪器性能模拟在数量级内验证了该观测率；将筛选条件应用于由固定率软件触发数据随机配对的射电—闪烁体合成数据集，估计背景为 **0.11 个事件**。重建的信号偏振角与纯地磁辐射一致，并可与多类背景区分。
summary: At energies above 100 PeV, coherent radio frequency (RF) emission across the 10 -- 1000 MHz band from cosmic particle-induced atmospheric showers becomes increasingly dominant, making radio detection a powerful probe at ultrahigh energies. The Beamforming Elevated Array for COsmic Neutrinos (BEACON) considers mountaintop phased radio arrays to monitor large areas at the horizon for upward-going geomagnetic emission in the 30 -- 80 MHz band produced as a consequence of Earth-skimming tau neutrinos. As part of ongoing efforts to measure the sensitivity of BEACON to such signals, the BEACON prototype identifies cosmic rays through the same emission mechanism. Prior to 2023, BEACON operated a four-antenna prototype, which successfully demonstrated identification of coherent and impulsive sources using a beamforming RF trigger. In 2023, we upgraded the instrument to six newly designed antennas and added an independent scintillator array to cross-validate radio-detectable cosmic rays. This work details the observation of 22 candidate cosmic-ray events in a scintillator-coincidence-triggered dataset using selection cuts based on expected radio characteristics. A simulation of the hybrid-instrument performance verifies this observation rate to within an order of magnitude. We estimate a background of 0.11 events by applying the selection cuts to synthetic datasets of uncorrelated radio-scintillator pairs that are randomly formed using fixed-rate software-triggered data. The reconstructed signal polarization angles are consistent with pure geomagnetic emission compared to various background classes.

title: How general relativity stacks up: Testing gravity by coherently combining gravitational-wave observations
background_knowledge: 引力波天文学通过测量时空度规的微小扰动，研究强引力场、高速运动及高曲率条件下的物理。致密双星（黑洞或中子星）并合产生的啁啾信号包含旋近、并合和铃宕等阶段的丰富信息；广义相对论（GR）对这些波形有确定预言，因此可以把观测到的应变与理论模板做匹配滤波和贝叶斯推断，从而检验 GR。传统检验通常针对单个事件引入偏离参数，例如修正后牛顿系数、铃宕频率与衰减率、引力波传播效应等，但单个事件的信噪比有限。群体层面检验依赖层级贝叶斯框架：把多个并合事件视为来自同一总体，联合推断偏离参数随质量、自旋等总体变量的分布，并控制波形系统误差与选择效应。关键挑战在于偏离信号可能很弱、参数简并强，且不同事件对偏差的敏感度不同；相干联合多个事件可提升统计显著度，并刻画偏差在事件之间的系统变化。
contribution: 论文提出一个框架，通过相干联合多个引力波测量，在群体层面检验超越 GR 的物理。该框架假设偏离 GR 的效应满足三个条件：（i）在并合附近最强；（ii）随双星总质量 $M$ 平滑变化；（iii）在最显著的 $\ell=|m|=2$ 模式中最突出。作者将该框架应用于 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第五版引力波瞬变星表（GWTC-5）中 28 个高信噪比双黑洞并合事件，**未发现偏离 GR 的证据**。该分析还能重建可能的偏离随系统总质量的变化，并论证这种重建有助于令人信服地区分波形系统误差与真实的 GR 破坏。
summary: A core mission of gravitational-wave astronomy is to test general relativity (GR) in the high-curvature, high-velocity regime. The field has already seen significant progress in this space, though a remaining challenge is how to combine data from a population of binary mergers. This can both boost the significance of potential GR violations, and develop a phenomenological picture of how deviations manifest in different mergers. We propose a framework to coherently combine gravitational-wave measurements to build a population-level test of physics beyond GR. We assume that deviations from GR are (i) strongest near the merger, (ii) vary smoothly with the total mass of the binary, and (iii) are most prominent in the $\ell=|m|=2$ mode. While these assumptions do not describe every possible deviation of GR, they provide us with a plausible starting point upon which a more general framework can be built. We apply our framework to 28 high signal-to-noise ratio binary black hole mergers from LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA's Fifth Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog, finding no evidence for deviations from GR. Our framework allows one to show how deviations could vary as a function of total mass of the system. We argue that such a reconstruction can be used to convincingly distinguish between systematic waveform errors and genuine GR violations.

title: A Little Red Dot emerging from a nitrogen-rich UV-luminous galaxy with Very Massive Stars
background_knowledge: JWST 的高灵敏度红外光谱把高红移星系的静止紫外与光学观测推进到 $z>6$。在星系演化框架中，年轻恒星星族的紫外连续谱斜率 $\beta_{\rm UV}$ 与尘埃、年龄和金属丰度有关；强禁线或互组合线（如 N IV] $\lambda1486$、C III] $\lambda\lambda1906/1909$、He II $\lambda1640$）可诊断电离源、电子密度和化学丰度。极高质量恒星（very massive stars，VMSs；$>100\ M_\odot$）具有硬电离谱、强 He II 发射与 P Cygni 轮廓，并可通过旋转混合和 CNO 循环产生高 N/C。N/O、C/O 与 N/C 是化学演化的重要指针：超太阳 N/O 与亚太阳 C/O 往往要求非标准富集过程。Little Red Dots（LRDs）是 JWST 发现的高红移紧凑红色天体，常呈 V 形 SED、宽 Balmer 线及 Balmer 吸收，可能与早期黑洞增长或致密星团中的黑洞种子有关。恒星族合成模型可把 UV 连续谱、吸收线和发射线联合拟合，用来检验 VMS 是否存在以及星族随时间的快速演化。
contribution: 作者利用 NIRSpec 中分辨率光谱研究 $z=6.6$ 的明亮星系 COLA1（$M_{\rm UV}=-21.3$），其 UV 连续谱呈蓝色（$\beta_{\rm UV}=-2.5$），并出现 N IV] $\lambda1486$、恒星 P Cygni 轮廓和宽 He II $\lambda1640$ 等强发射线。将 UV 与包含 VMS（上限 $300\ M_\odot$）的恒星族模型比较，**含 VMS 的模型在统计上更受偏好**；最佳拟合星族为 $M_*\approx10^8\ M_\odot$、年龄 $2.4\pm0.8$ Myr。静止光学连续谱更红（$\beta_{\rm opt}=-1.1$），宽 Balmer 线叠加 Balmer 吸收，与 LRD 光谱相似。演化最佳拟合星族表明 UV 可在约 $5$ Myr 内变暗 $1$–$2$ mag，因此 **COLA1 可能在此后表现为典型的 V 形 LRD**。作者测得 $\log_{10}(\mathrm{N/O})=-0.07\pm0.05$（超太阳）与 $\log_{10}(\mathrm{C/O})=-0.64\pm0.11$（亚太阳），故 $\log_{10}(\mathrm{N/C})=+0.58\pm0.12$；密度敏感的 N IV] $\lambda\lambda1483,1486$ 与 C III] $\lambda\lambda1906/1909$ 线比要求存在两个区：$n_e\gtrsim10^{6.5}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-3}$ 的致密区与 $n_e\lesssim10^{3.5}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-3}$ 的低密度区。致密区需 $\log_{10}(\mathrm{N/C})>1.3$（$2\sigma$），**这要求极端的 N/C 富集机制，如高速旋转的 $>100\ M_\odot$ VMS、潮汐瓦解事件或超大质量恒星**。作者进一步推测，致密星团中大质量恒星的失控碰撞可能导致中等质量黑洞种子形成，并最终产生 LRD。
summary: JWST is revealing abundant populations of high-$z$ galaxies with unforeseen properties: UV-luminous galaxies with high nitrogen enrichment, populations of very massive stars (VMSs; $>100\ M_\odot$), and early forms of massive black hole growth such as the Little Red Dots (LRDs). Here we present all these phenomena appearing simultaneously in COLA1, a luminous ($M_{\rm UV}=-21.3$) galaxy at $z=6.6$. New NIRSpec medium-resolution data reveal a blue UV continuum ($β_{\rm UV}=-2.5$) with strong emission lines including NIV] $\lambda1486$, stellar P Cygni profiles, and broad HeII $\lambda1640$. We fit the UV with stellar population models, and find that the models including VMSs (limited to $300\ M_\odot$) are statistically preferred. The best-fit stellar population has $M_*\approx10^8\ M_\odot$, and a young age of $2.4\pm0.8$ Myr. The rest-optical shows a redder continuum ($β_{\rm opt}=-1.1$) and broad Balmer lines with Balmer absorption akin to LRD spectra. By evolving the best-fit stellar population we find that the UV could dim by 1-2 mag in $\sim5$ Myr, and hence this system would be observed as a typical V-shaped LRD. We measure a supersolar $\rm log_{10}(N/O)=-0.07\pm0.05$ and subsolar $\rm log_{10}(C/O)=-0.64\pm0.11$; therefore $\rm log_{10}(N/C)=+0.58\pm0.12$. The independent density-sensitive NIV] $λ\lambda1483,1486$ and CIII] $λ\lambda1906/1909$ ratios require two zones with $n_e\gtrsim10^{6.5}$ cm$^{-3}$ and $n_e\lesssim10^{3.5}$ cm$^{-3}$, respectively. We estimate $\rm log_{10}(N/C)>1.3$ (2$σ$) for the dense zone, requiring extreme N/C enrichment mechanisms such as highly rotating $>100\ M_\odot$ VMSs, tidal disruption events, or supermassive stars. We speculate that runaway collisions of massive stars in a dense stellar cluster may have lead to the seeding of an intermediate-mass black hole resulting in the formation of an LRD.

title: Cosmology of self-interacting ultralight dark matter: simultaneous shifts in the Hubble constant and structure growth
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学以 ΛCDM 模型为基准：冷暗物质通过引力主导结构形成，暗能量驱动晚期加速膨胀，原初近标度不变扰动经历辐射主导、物质主导时期，最终形成宇宙微波背景（CMB）各向异性与大尺度结构。CMB 声学峰位置由声视界与角直径距离之比 $\theta_*$ 标定；在固定 $\theta_*$ 下，$H_0$ 与复合前膨胀历史、辐射与暗物质组分以及声视界紧密相关。另一方面，晚期物质功率谱振幅常由 $\sigma_8$ 与 $\Omega_m$ 的组合表征，弱引力透镜和星系巡天提示 $S_8=\sigma_8(\Omega_m/0.3)^{0.5}$ 可能低于 Planck ΛCDM 预言，这构成 Hubble tension 与结构增长 tension。超轻暗物质由极轻标量场凝聚而成，具有较大的 Compton/Jeans 尺度，可在小尺度抑制结构；若该场具有自相互作用，其早期演化可经历 Hubble-frozen 阶段、四次方主导的辐射样阶段和二次方主导的物质样阶段，从而同时改变复合前膨胀率与晚期聚集。此类模型因此成为连接暗物质微观物理、CMB 声视界和结构增长的探针。
contribution: 论文构建并实现了混合冷暗物质与自相互作用超轻暗物质的宇宙学模型：标量场从早期 Hubble-frozen 阶段演化到四次方主导的辐射样阶段，再到二次方主导的物质样阶段；中间阶段提高复合前膨胀率并减小声视界，晚期同一场又可充当暗物质。作者在 CLASS 中加入该模型的背景与线性扰动。取 $m=10^{-22}\,{\rm eV}$、$\tilde m\simeq1\,{\rm eV}$ 时，随着超轻暗物质比例增加，固定 $\theta_*$ 下的 $H_0$ 被抬高，晚期聚集振幅降低，物质功率谱出现更强的尺度相关抑制，CMB 温度残差平滑达到约 $9\%$（最大比例情形）。因此模型可在与 Hubble tension 和结构增长 tension 相关的方向上同时产生背景与增长移动；**这些移动能否改善联合拟合仍需基于似然的观测分析确定**。
summary: We study the cosmology of self-interacting ultralight dark matter. The scalar field evolves from an early Hubble-frozen phase to a quartic-dominated radiation-like phase and finally to a quadratic matter-like phase. The intermediate phase increases the pre-recombination expansion rate and reduces the sound horizon, while the late phase allows the same field to contribute to dark matter. We implement the background and linear perturbations of a mixed cold-dark-matter and ultralight-dark-matter cosmology in CLASS. For $m=10^{-22}\,{\rm eV}$ and $\tilde m\simeq1\,{\rm eV}$, increasing the ultralight-dark-matter fraction raises the fixed-$θ_*$ value of $H_0$, lowers the late-time clustering amplitude, strengthens the scale-dependent matter-power suppression, and produces a smooth CMB-temperature residual reaching about $9\%$ for the largest fraction considered. The model therefore generates simultaneous background and growth shifts in the directions relevant to the Hubble and structure-growth tensions. Establishing whether these shifts improve a joint fit requires a likelihood-level observational analysis.

title: The Structural Anatomy of Galaxies: Environmental Dependence of Morphological and Quenching Evolution at 0.1 < z < 0.5
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究星系如何从早期宇宙的气体坍缩、冷却和恒星形成，逐步组装成今日所见的盘星系、椭球星系以及星系群与星系团成员。其核心物理图像是：暗物质晕提供引力势阱，重子气体冷却后形成恒星；恒星形成、超新星与 AGN 反馈、并合以及环境作用共同调节星系的质量、形态和恒星族群。观测上常用静止系 UVJ 颜色图区分「恒星形成」与「静止」星系，并用比恒星形成率 sSFR、Hα 光度、$D_n4000$ 等示踪恒星形成历史与年龄。环境淬灭指星系进入星系团或星系群环境后，因冲压剥离、strangulation、潮汐剥离、星系 harassment、并合增强及 AGN 反馈等过程而失去冷气体，恒星形成被抑制；同时，星系形态可由盘状、有棒或旋臂结构向核球占优、早型转变。经典「形态—密度关系」表明高密度环境中早型、静止星系比例更高，但环境究竟先抑制恒星形成再改变结构，还是结构转变与淬灭同步发生，仍是开放问题。绿谷星系是介于恒星形成主序与静止星系之间的过渡族群，其结构、年龄和 SFR 的组合可为淬灭路径提供关键线索。本论文所在子领域正是通过星系团卫星星系与场星系对照，定量检验环境对恒星形成和结构演化的影响。
contribution: 论文利用 X 射线选出的 eROSITA 星系团样本中经光谱确认的星系，结合 HSC-SSP 深成像与 DESI DR1 光谱，在 $0.1<z<0.5$ 比较星系团卫星星系与按恒星质量和红移匹配的场星系对照样本，测量经尘埃改正的 $\mathrm{H\alpha}$ 恒星形成率、有效半径 $R_{\rm e}$、核球光度占比 $B/T$ 与 $D_n4000$。作者用 UVJ 图选出静止星系，并将 UVJ 恒星形成族群在 $\log(\mathrm{sSFR}_{\rm H\alpha})=-10.5\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$ 处分为活跃恒星形成星系与 $\mathrm{H\alpha}$-low 星系，后者即绿谷星系。主要发现是：星系团—场差异强烈依赖恒星质量、投影团心距和星系族群；团内恒星形成星系仅显示 **温和的 SFR 抑制而结构偏移很弱**；最强的联合信号出现在 $\mathrm{H\alpha}$-low 的 UVJ 恒星形成星系中，尤其是 $R<0.5R_{500}$ 的低质量卫星星系，它们相较匹配场星系具有 **更低的 SFR、更小的光权重尺寸、更大的 $B/T$ 和更大的 $D_n4000$**；静止星系的结构偏移较弱，但仍保留 **正的 $D_n4000$ 残差**。作者进一步用基于 SFR、$R_{\rm e}$、$B/T$、$D_n4000$ 匹配残差和场—场参考协方差的 Mahalanobis 距离量化联合偏移，发现 **多变量偏移在低质量绿谷星系中最大，并随投影团心距增大而减小**。由于 SFR 抑制的径向范围比结构偏移更广，作者推论 **恒星形成抑制的环境作用范围比结构转变更宽**，并指出 **环境淬灭与结构转变在 $\mathrm{H\alpha}$-low 过渡族群中耦合最强**。
summary: We investigate how cluster environments affect galaxy star formation, structure, and stellar populations using spectroscopically-confirmed galaxies in X-ray-selected eROSITA clusters, that have deep HSC-SSP imaging and DESI DR1 spectroscopy. At 0.1<z<0.5, we compare dust-corrected Ha star formation rates (SFRs), effective radii (Re), bulge-to-total light ratios (B/T), and Dn4000 between cluster satellites and a stellar-mass- and redshift-matched field control sample. We identify UVJ-quiescent galaxies and divide the UVJ star-forming population at log(sSFR_Ha)= -10.5 yr-1 into actively star-forming and Ha-low systems, the latter referred to as green-valley (GV) galaxies. Cluster--field differences depend strongly on stellar mass, projected cluster-centric radius, and galaxy population. Cluster star-forming galaxies show modest SFR suppression but weak structural offsets. The strongest coupled signatures occur among Ha-low UVJ-star-forming galaxies, particularly low-mass satellites at R<0.5R500, which have lower SFRs, smaller light-weighted sizes, larger B/T, and larger Dn4000 than matched field counterparts. Quiescent galaxies show weaker structural offsets but retain a positive Dn4000 residual. We quantify the joint signal using a Mahalanobis distance based on matched residuals in SFR, Re, B/T, and Dn4000 with a field--field reference covariance. The multivariate offset is largest for low-mass GV galaxies and decreases toward larger projected radius. The broader radial extent of SFR suppression relative to structural offsets suggests that star-formation suppression has a broader environmental reach than structural transformation. These results show that environmental quenching and structural transformation are most strongly coupled in the Ha-low transition population.

title: Triaxiality of the Milky Way dark matter halo and the microlensing optical depth towards the Large Magellanic Cloud
background_knowledge: 微引力透镜是研究银河系暗物质晕及其中致密天体比例的重要手段：若晕中存在相当比例的致密天体（如 MACHO 或原初黑洞），它们会短暂增亮背景恒星，例如 LMC 中的恒星。微引力透镜光学深度 $ \tau $ 表示沿给定视线发生放大的概率；对点透镜而言，它与单个透镜质量无关，而正比于视线方向上的致密天体质量柱密度，因而可用于限制暗物质晕的致密天体比例。传统分析多假设银河系暗物质晕为球对称，并采用 NFW、Einasto 或对数势等密度剖面；但数值模拟和观测（包括 Gaia 恒星运动学与旋转曲线）表明，晕可能呈三轴椭球。三轴性会改变不同视线方向的柱密度，从而改变 $ \tau_{\rm LMC} $，并影响 EROS-2、OGLE 等微引力透镜巡天给出的致密天体比例上限。
contribution: 本文计算 LMC 方向三轴暗物质晕的微引力透镜光学深度 $ \tau_{\rm LMC} $，并表明形状依赖完全由视线相对晕主轴的投影承载。在固定局部密度下，对幂律晕 $ \rho\propto R^{-\alpha} $，结果可严格因子化为 $ \tau/\tau_{\rm sph}=S_\odot^\alpha\langle S^{-\alpha}\rangle_w $，其中 $ S(\Omega) $ 为椭球形状函数。LMC 与太阳—银心连线的垂线仅相差 $ 0.78^\circ $，因此它是探测晕面内拉长的近最优探针，而对垂向压扁不敏感。对于 Gaia 所偏好的晕形状，在固定局部密度下得到 $ \tau_{\rm LMC}/\tau_{\rm sph}=0.95 $--$ 1.15 $，Law-Majewski 对数势给出 $ 1.57 $，而放开主轴方位时范围为 $ 0.67 $--$ 1.54 $。对于 Gaia DR3 旋转曲线所需的 Einasto 晕，$ 25\,\mathrm{kpc} $ 附近的截断被其隐含的更大局部密度抵消，$ \tau $ 仅下降 $ 7 $--$ 15\% $；但中位透镜距离由 $ 13.4\,\mathrm{kpc} $ 内移至 $ 8.5\,\mathrm{kpc} $，该处对数斜率更陡且上升，从而放大形状敏感性：Gaia RR Lyrae 增强由 $ 15\% $ 增至 $ 23\% $，无方向先验时的范围扩大为 $ 0.62 $--$ 1.62 $。**三轴性对推断的 MACHO 或原初黑洞比例造成双向系统偏差：实测形状下约为 $ \pm 15\% $，完全放开主轴方位时可达 $ 2.6 $ 倍，超过 EROS-2 与 OGLE 上限的统计误差。**
summary: The microlensing optical depth towards the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC), $τ_{\rm LMC}$, bounds the compact-object fraction of the Galactic dark matter halo, but is almost always evaluated for a spherical halo. We compute it for triaxial haloes and show that the shape dependence is carried entirely by the projection of the line of sight onto the halo principal axes: for a scale-free halo $ρ\propto R^{-α}$ at fixed local density it factorises exactly as $τ/τ_{\rm sph}=S_\odot^α\langle S^{-α}\rangle_w$, with $S(Ω)$ the ellipsoidal shape function. The LMC lies only $0\fdg78$ from perpendicular to the Sun-Galactic Centre line, making it a near-optimal probe of in-plane elongation and a poor probe of vertical flattening. For the halo shapes favoured by \textit{Gaia} we find $τ_{\rm LMC}/τ_{\rm sph}=0.95$--$1.15$ at fixed local density, $1.57$ for the Law-Majewski logarithmic potential, and $0.67$--$1.54$ when the major-axis azimuth is left free. For the Einasto halo required by the declining \textit{Gaia} DR3 rotation curve, truncation near $25\kpc$ is offset by the larger local density it implies and $τ$ falls by only $7$--$15$ per cent; but the median lens distance moves inwards from $13.4$ to $8.5\kpc$, where the logarithmic slope is steep and rising, amplifying the shape sensitivity: the \textit{Gaia} RR~Lyrae enhancement grows from $15$ to $23$ per cent and the orientation-free range widens to $0.62$--$1.62$. The systematic on the inferred MACHO or primordial-black-hole fraction is two-sided, of order $\pm15$ per cent for the measured shapes and a factor $2.6$ under full orientation freedom, exceeding the statistical errors of the EROS-2 and OGLE bounds.

title: B-fields In STar-forming Region Observations (BISTRO): Dual-Wavelength Constraints on Size-Dependent Grain Alignment in Star-Forming Regions
background_knowledge: 星际介质中的尘埃会吸收星光并再辐射；在光学薄亚毫米热辐射中，非球形尘埃颗粒可沿磁场方向择优取向，使尘粒热辐射产生偏振，因此亚毫米偏振是描绘分子云和恒星形成区磁场几何的重要探针。颗粒取向效率通常依赖颗粒大小、辐射场强度与光谱、气体密度和温度等；不同波长观测到的是不同大小与温度尘埃群体的加权辐射，故比较 450 与 850 μm 偏振可检验颗粒取向机制。常用总强度谱指数 $\alpha$（$I\propto\nu^{\alpha}$）与偏振强度谱指数 $\gamma$（$PI\propto\nu^{\gamma}$）的差异、以及偏振度随波长的变化来约束尘埃性质；但温度混合、光学厚度、尘埃发射率谱和颗粒磁性等也会影响观测量，需要气体温度等外部数据交叉检验。
contribution: 论文在 $12.6''$ 分辨率下比较 JCMT 的 450 与 850 μm POL-2 观测，发现 21 个区域中偏振角绝对差的中位数为 $6.7^\circ$。对 35 个区域，按 $I\propto\nu^{\alpha}$、$PI\propto\nu^{\gamma}$ 拟合，其中 24–27 个区域有 $\gamma<\alpha$（在计入弱偏振强度的 $3\sigma$ 限后统计）。全部样本的 $\gamma-\alpha$ 中位数为 $-0.51$，在上述限制下范围为 $-0.57$ 至 $-0.45$；偏振度比为 $P_{450}/P_{850}=0.69\pm0.02_{\rm sys}\pm0.03_{\rm stat}$，且未检测到其与偏振角差的相关性。作者提出，**颗粒取向效率随尘埃颗粒大小变化是同时解释这些双波段结果的最简单机制**。作为替代，论文检验了光学薄、偏振角与不透明度定律相同的冷、暖尘埃温度混合模型：要复现 $-0.51$ 的中位数，暖尘埃的偏振效率必须低于冷尘埃；若冷尘埃温度不低于 10 K、暖尘埃不高于 40 K，则要求暖、冷有效偏振效率比 $r\lesssim0.18$。在 4 个场中，以不透明度指数 $\beta=2$ 的混合模型对照 Herschel 尘埃温度和 Green Bank Ammonia Survey 动力学温度，并假设气尘温度相等、氨分子示踪冷气体、冷尘埃为 3–20 K、暖尘埃为 25–40 K 且质量占比至多一半；即使取 $r=0$，其中 3 个场（暂定包括 OMC 2）也无法在 $1\sigma$ 内同时满足两类温度并复现 $\gamma-\alpha$。放宽到暖尘埃 10–100 K、质量占比至多 95% 时，仅允许 $r\le0.041$ 的解。若要用温度混合解释这 3 个场，需要更宽的温度模型范围和非常强的偏振效率反差，而该反差的物理起源仍无法确定。**总体上，观测更倾向于尺寸依赖的颗粒取向，而非简单温度混合。**
summary: We compared 450 and 850 $μ$m POL-2 observations from the James Clerk Maxwell Telescope at $12.6''$ resolution. The median absolute difference in polarization angle between bands is $6.7^\circ$ across 21 regions. For total intensity $I\proptoν^α$ and polarized intensity $PI\proptoν^γ$, 24-27 of 35 regions have $γ<α$, allowing for $3σ$ limits on weak polarized intensities. The median $γ-α$ is $-0.51$, ranging from $-0.57$ to $-0.45$ under these limits. The ratio of polarization fractions is $P_{450}/P_{850}=0.69\pm0.02_{\rm sys}\pm0.03_{\rm stat}$, with no detected dependence on the angle difference. We suggest that the dependence of alignment on grain size offers the simplest explanation of these findings. For optically thin components sharing a polarization angle and opacity law, temperature mixing reproduces the median $-0.51$ only if the warm dust is polarized less efficiently than the cold dust. If the cold dust is at 10 K or warmer and the warm dust at 40 K or cooler, the median requires a ratio of warm to cold effective polarization efficiencies $r\lesssim0.18$. We tested mixtures with opacity index $β=2$ in four fields against Herschel dust temperatures and Green Bank Ammonia Survey kinetic temperatures. We assumed equal gas and dust temperatures, ammonia tracing cold gas, and model ranges of 3-20 K for cold dust and 25-40 K for warm dust carrying at most half the mass. Mixtures matching both temperatures cannot reproduce $γ-α$ within $1σ$ in three fields, including OMC 2 tentatively, even for $r=0$. Allowing warm dust at 10-100 K and up to 95% of the mass permits solutions only for $r\leq0.041$. To explain these three fields by temperature mixing, we need wider model ranges and a very strong contrast in polarization efficiency. The origin of this contrast remains undetermined.

title: B-fields In STar-forming Region Observations (BISTRO): Technical Foundations for Quantitative 450/850 $μ$m JCMT SCUBA-2/POL-2 Polarimetry
background_knowledge:
分子云与恒星形成研究关注引力、湍流、磁场和辐射反馈如何共同决定云核演化与恒星诞生。磁场无法直接看见，但可由尘埃热辐射的线偏振示踪：在亚毫米/毫米波段，非球形尘埃颗粒沿磁场方向有效排列，其热辐射带有偏振，偏振方向给出磁场在天空平面的投影，偏振度则与颗粒排列效率、尘埃性质、辐射几何及波长有关。常用 Stokes 参量描述偏振：$I$ 为总强度，$Q$ 与 $U$ 为线偏振分量，偏振度 $p=\sqrt{Q^2+U^2}/I$、偏振角 $\psi=0.5\arctan(U/Q)$。多波段偏振还可结合修正黑体谱 $I_
u \propto 
u^ eta B_
u(T_d)$ 中的尘埃发射率指数 $ eta$ 研究尘埃演化。观测上需在分子云大尺度成图，并控制仪器偏振、扩展源定标、噪声、零基线、束斑与角尺度匹配等系统误差，才能可靠比较偏振分数、谱指数与偏振角，并与 SOFIA/HAWC+、ALMA 等数据联合。JCMT 的 SCUBA-2/POL-2 提供 450 与 850 $\mu$m 偏振成图，是 BISTRO 等项目的核心手段，其定量化技术基础对理解分子云磁场与恒星形成至关重要。
contribution: 论文利用 174 个档案观测场（覆盖 69 个分子云区域，并按各项检验选取子集），系统给出 JCMT SCUBA-2/POL-2 在 450 与 850 $\mu$m 偏振测量的五项技术验证。第一，**扩展源定标可避免因用峰值亮度定标扩展辐射而导致的尘埃发射率指数确定性偏移 $\Delta\beta=-1.05$**，防止该系统性偏差进入 $\beta$ 图。第二，用加性与信号相关分量建模 Stokes $I$ 噪声，测得 450/850 $\mu$m 表面亮度噪声中位比为 25；对 Stokes $Q$、$U$ 噪声的独立检验支持近似相等的加性方差与弱误差相关，为偏振不确定度传播提供依据。第三，**逐场改正确认可将 450 $\mu$m 的 Stokes $Q$、$U$ 中约 $\sim 1\ \mathrm{mJy}\ \mathrm{arcsec}^{-2}$ 的加性零基线偏移压低，三步回归后残余联合振幅中位数为 $0.07\ \mathrm{mJy}\ \mathrm{arcsec}^{-2}$**；与 SOFIA/HAWC+ 在 154 与 214 $\mu$m 的独立比较支持强受影响场的改正。第四，将 450 $\mu$m 图匹配到模型化的 850 $\mu$m 束斑及 $12.6^{\prime\prime}$–$300^{\prime\prime}$ 共同角尺度范围，并对 30 个源的同一批 450 $\mu$m 数据比较三种还原结果；**束斑匹配使源间中位角残差由 $6.3^\circ$ 降至 $4.7^\circ$**，匹配后 30 个源中有 29 个的中位残差低于 $10^\circ$。第五，量化残余 $Q/U$ 零偏在偏振分数比值、谱指数差与偏振角中的传播。上述验证为解释 POL-2 测量及与其他波段偏振数据联合分析提供了流程与定量参考。
summary: We present five technical validations of SCUBA-2/POL-2 polarimetry on the James Clerk Maxwell Telescope at 450 and 850 $μ$m, using 174 archival fields in 69 molecular cloud regions and subsets appropriate to each test. Extended-source calibration avoids a deterministic shift of $Δβ=-1.05$ in the dust emissivity index $β$ that would result from calibrating extended emission using peak brightness. We modeled Stokes $I$ noise with additive and signal-dependent components. The measured median ratio of surface-brightness noise at 450/850 $μ$m is 25. Independent tests of Stokes $Q,U$ noise support approximately equal additive variances and weak error correlations, providing a basis for propagating polarization uncertainties. Corrections determined for individual fields reduce additive zero-level offsets of order $1$ mJy arcsec$^{-2}$ in the 450 $μ$m Stokes $Q$ and $U$ intensities. The three-step regression leaves a median combined residual amplitude of $0.07$ mJy arcsec$^{-2}$. Independent comparisons with SOFIA/HAWC+ at 154 and 214 $μ$m support the correction in strongly affected fields. We matched the 450 $μ$m maps to the modeled 850 $μ$m beam and the common $12.6''$-$300''$ range of angular scales. We compared three reductions of the same 450 $μ$m observations across 30 sources. Taking the median angular residual relative to the final product for each source, we find that beam matching reduces the median over sources from $6.3^\circ$ to $4.7^\circ$. After matching, 29 of the 30 sources have median residuals below $10^\circ$. We also quantified how residual $Q/U$ offsets propagate in ratios of polarization fractions, differences in spectral indices, and polarization angles. These validations provide procedures and quantitative references for interpreting POL-2 measurements and combining them with polarimetry at other wavelengths.

title: Chemical abundance patterns at z=1-7: Carbon, Nitrogen, Neon, Sulphur, and Argon abundances from JWST spectroscopy
background_knowledge:
星系际介质与星际介质中的元素丰度记录了宇宙恒星形成、反馈与化学富集的历史。大爆炸核合成主要产生 H、He 和少量 Li；C、N、O、Ne、S、Ar 等元素主要由恒星核合成产生，并通过星风、AGB 星、核心坍缩超新星和 Ia 型超新星注入 ISM。不同元素的生产场所与时标不同：O、Ne、S、Ar 等 $\alpha$ 元素主要来自大质量恒星的核心坍缩超新星；N 兼具初级与次级核合成来源；C 可由 AGB 星和超新星贡献；S 与 Ar 还会受到延迟的 SNe Ia 富集影响。因此，丰度比随金属丰度、恒星质量和红移的变化，可以用来约束恒星形成效率、初始质量函数、气体流入流出以及超新星延迟富集。
\n观测上，$\mathrm{O/H}$ 常被用作金属丰度的基准。直接法依赖探测 [O III] $\lambda 4363$ 等弱极光线的电子温度 $T_e$，结果较可靠，但在高红移较难获得；强线标定可扩大样本，但需要仔细考虑电离参数与选择效应。JWST/NIRSpec 使 $z \sim 1$–$7$ 静止光学发射线的超深光谱成为可能，从而能够把本地丰度关系检验到宇宙早期。
contribution:
论文结合 MARTA 巡天的超深 JWST/NIRSpec 光谱与档案光谱，构建了 $z = 1$–$7$ 的恒星形成星系样本。其中 244 个星系探测到 [O III] $\lambda 4363$，用于基于电子温度 $T_e$ 的直接丰度测量；并给出 $\mathrm{N/O}$、$\mathrm{Ne/O}$、$\mathrm{S/O}$、$\mathrm{Ar/O}$ 的新经验强线标定，将分析扩展至另外 514 个星系。
\n结果显示，不同丰度比呈现出不同的金属丰度趋势：**$\mathrm{N/O}$ 的中位值相对本地星系高 $0.18$ dex，并且在低金属丰度处增强更明显**；**直接测量显示 $\mathrm{S/O}$ 与 $\mathrm{Ar/O}$ 随金属丰度升高而下降，而强线测量暗示较高金属丰度处趋于平坦，$\mathrm{S/O}$ 尤为明显**。在 $\mathrm{O/Ar}$–$\mathrm{Ar/H}$ 平面上，作者发现存在恒星质量依赖：**固定 $\mathrm{Ar/H}$ 时，低质量星系具有更低的 $\mathrm{O/Ar}$**，这与恒星形成效率差异以及延迟的 SNe Ia 富集相符。**$\mathrm{Ne/O}$ 在 $12 + \log(\mathrm{O/H}) = 8.2$ 以下近似恒定，在更高金属丰度处略有上升，且没有显著的红移演化**；$\mathrm{C/O}$ 则 tentatively 随金属丰度增加，总体跟随本地关系。最后，前向模型表明观测选择会以不同方式影响各丰度比：**选择效应主要限制 $\mathrm{Ne/O}$ 与 $\mathrm{Ar/O}$ 可访问的金属丰度范围，却会优先选出低金属丰度下 $\mathrm{N/O}$ 增强的星系，对 $\mathrm{S/O}$ 的影响较弱**。这些结果为高红移化学富集提供了新约束，并强调解释丰度–金属丰度趋势时必须考虑选择效应。
summary: The relative abundances of chemical elements in the interstellar medium (ISM) trace the history of star formation and chemical enrichment in galaxies. We investigate the abundance patterns of carbon (C), nitrogen (N), neon (Ne), sulfur (S), and argon (Ar) in star-forming galaxies at z=1-7, combining ultra-deep JWST/NIRSpec observations from the MARTA survey with archival spectroscopy. We assemble 244 galaxies with [OIII]4363 detections and derive direct Te-based abundances. New empirical strong-line calibrations for N/O, Ne/O, S/O, and Ar/O extend the analysis to an additional 514 galaxies. We find distinct abundance-metallicity trends. N/O is enhanced by 0.18 dex in median relative to local galaxies, with a stronger enhancement at low metallicity. Direct measurements reveal decreasing S/O and Ar/O with increasing metallicity, while strong-line measurements suggest a flattening at higher metallicities, especially for S/O. We also identify a stellar-mass dependence in the O/Ar-Ar/H plane, with lower-mass galaxies exhibiting lower O/Ar at fixed Ar/H, consistent with differences in star-formation efficiency and delayed SNe Ia enrichment. Ne/O remains approximately constant up to 12+log(O/H)=8.2, with a mild increase at higher metallicities and no significant redshift evolution. C/O tentatively increases with metallicity, broadly following the local relation. Finally, a forward model shows that observational selection affects the abundance ratios differently: it mainly restricts the accessible metallicity range for Ne/O and Ar/O, but preferentially selects galaxies with enhanced N/O at low metallicity, with a weaker effect for S/O. These results provide new constraints on chemical enrichment at high redshift and highlight the importance of accounting for selection effects when interpreting abundance-metallicity trends.

title: Testing the statistical compatibility of data sets with a common prior
background_knowledge: 该工作属于天体物理与宇宙学数据分析中的统计方法研究。现代观测通常把来自不同实验、不同波段或不同宇宙学探针的数据集联合起来，在同一个理论模型下拟合参数，并判断这些数据是否相互兼容。常见做法是构造似然函数或 $\chi^2$，区分模型参数与 nuisance 参数，并可能引入外部先验约束。参数拟合优度（Parameter Goodness-of-fit，PG）检验通过比较各数据集单独拟合与联合拟合的 $\chi^2$ 改善量来检验兼容性；其原始形式默认各数据集统计独立。若多个数据集共享同一个外部先验，则它们经由该先验产生相关性，独立性假设被破坏，需要新的检验统计量分布。广义 $\chi^2$ 分布可表示为一组独立 $\chi^2$ 变量的加权和，常用于处理相关性或非标准自由度情形，并由其计算 $p$ 值。
contribution: 论文针对各数据集共享辅助先验、从而不再统计独立的情形，提出了 Parameter Goodness-of-fit（PG）检验的扩展。作者证明：在 Gaussian 近似下，带先验约束的 PG 统计量服从广义 $\chi^2$ 分布，因此可以直接计算 $p$ 值；**在强先验约束近似下，该检验收敛到未受约束模型参数的标准 PG 检验**。核心贡献是给出共享先验导致数据集相关时一种简单可行的兼容性检验框架。
summary: The Parameter Goodness-of-fit (PG) test [hep-ph/0304176] offers a simple test statistic to study the compatibility of different data sets within a given theoretical model. In its original formulation it assumes that the data sets are statistically independent. We propose an extension of the PG test for the situation when some parameters of the model are constrained by an auxiliary data set called prior here. As the prior is imposed for all data sets, they are no longer statistically independent. We show that under the Gaussian approximation, the prior-constrained PG test statistic follows a generalised $χ^2$ distribution, which can be used to obtain $p$-values in a straight-forward way. In the approximation of a strong prior constraint, the test converges towards the standard PG test for the unconstrained model parameters.

title: PIANISTpy: A JAX-based Python package for velocity-anisotropic astrophysical equilibrium models
background_knowledge: 星系形成与演化研究暗物质晕和星系如何在层级并合、各向异性吸积与引力塌缩中形成，并如何通过无碰撞动力学弛豫达到准平衡。此类系统的相空间结构通常由分布函数描述：对球对称、无旋转系统，分布函数可写成 $f(E,L)$，其中 $E$ 与 $L$ 分别为比能和比角动量。速度各向异性常以各向异性参数 $\beta(r)=1-\sigma_t^2/(2\sigma_r^2)$ 参数化，其中 $\sigma_r$ 与 $\sigma_t$ 分别为径向和切向速度弥散。给定密度轮廓 $\rho(r)$ 与 $\beta(r)$，可通过 Eddington 型反演或 Osipkov--Merritt 等方法构造分布函数；有限空间范围还需在相空间截断，并保证分布函数非负、边界自洽且动力学稳定。数值研究通常从分布函数采样生成 N-body 初始条件。传统工具常默认各向同性速度分布，或采用不自洽的截断，从而引入初始条件不稳定；直接探测实验则常用 Maxwell--Boltzmann 速度分布近似。可微编程与 GPU 加速正在改变此类建模和推断流程。
contribution: 论文提出**首个在相空间实施截断的解析框架**，为有限空间范围提供完全自洽（物理且无不稳定）的截断边界条件，并给出两种方案，分别保证输出分布函数的单调性，或保证截断后的密度轮廓与目标密度轮廓完全一致。作者发布开源、基于 JAX 并支持 GPU 加速的 Python 包 PIANISTpy，用于构造球对称、无旋转系统的初始条件，支持任意双幂律解析径向密度轮廓和一组解析各向异性轮廓；还可将所有已实现解析各向异性模型作为基函数进行任意线性叠加，以构造非解析各向异性轮廓。PIANISTpy 能输出三维速度轮廓与视线积分观测量，并支持端到端可微，便于快速的基于梯度的 Monte Carlo 推断；同时可给出各向异性暗物质晕中自洽的本地暗物质速度分布，超越地面探测实验常用的非物理 Maxwell--Boltzmann 简化。与包括 galpy 和 AGAMA 在内的现有工具相比，论文展示了**数量级更高的数值求解精度**以及**更优的粒子初始条件动力学稳定性**。
summary: The hierarchical assembly of dark matter haloes and galaxies via mergers and anisotropic mass accretion naturally imprints non-trivial velocity anisotropy onto haloes and galaxies, an empirical fact emerging from cosmological simulations. However, dynamical studies based on idealised numerical simulations typically assume isotropic velocity distributions for the systems studied. This is mainly because no tools exist to construct anisotropic initial conditions with fully self-consistent (i.e., physical and instability-free) truncation boundary conditions for finite spatial extents. Here we present the first such analytical framework that performs truncation in phase space, with two distinct approaches to guarantee either the monotonicity of output distribution functions or identical truncated density profiles. We additionally present the open-source JAX-based GPU-accelerated Python package PIANISTpy (Particle Initial conditions with ANISoTropy) for constructing spherical, non-rotating initial conditions, supporting arbitrary double-power-law analytical radial density profiles and a library of analytical anisotropy profiles. This framework further permits the construction of systems with non-analytical anisotropy profiles via an arbitrary linear superposition of all implemented analytical anisotropy models as basis functions. PIANISTpy also outputs 3D velocity profiles and line-of-sight-integrated observables with end-to-end differentiability for rapid gradient-based Monte Carlo inference, and self-consistent local dark matter velocity distributions of anisotropic haloes beyond the unphysical Maxwell-Boltzmann simplification adopted in terrestrial detection experiments. We discuss use cases and demonstrate PIANISTpy's orders-of-magnitude higher numerical solver accuracy and superior dynamical stability of particle initial conditions relative to existing tools, including galpy and AGAMA.

title: Stellar Loci X: Selection of Nitrogen-Rich Giants Using GALEX NUV and Synthetic SDSS Photometry
background_knowledge: 在冷暗物质宇宙学框架下，银河系晕主要通过星系并合与吸积形成；球状星团是古老、致密的恒星系统，会在潮汐作用下瓦解，并把成员星抛入晕场。球状星团普遍存在多重星族：第二代星通常富氮，表现为 NH、CN 分子吸收增强，并伴随 C、O 降低以及 Na、Al 等元素异常。寻找这类富氮逃逸星，可为球状星团瓦解速率、晕的吸积历史和星团化学演化提供直接探针。传统上，氮增丰难以用宽带测光直接测量，但 NH、CN 吸收会压低光学 $u$ 波段流量，而近紫外（NUV）相对不受氮增丰影响、却对金属丰度敏感；因此把 NUV 与光学颜色结合，可在颜色-颜色图上建立随金属丰度变化的巨星恒星轨迹，并把显著偏离轨迹的星作为富氮候选。该研究范式属于银河系考古：用大规模测光筛选、再用光谱与运动学验证，从场星中识别被瓦解星团的遗迹。
contribution: 论文利用 GALEX NUV 测光与（合成）SDSS 光学测光，针对巨星构建随金属丰度变化的恒星轨迹模型；由于 NH、CN 吸收会压低 $u$ 波段流量，而 NUV 对氮增丰不敏感，作者将 $u-g$ 显著偏红的离群点选为富氮候选。**在宽松选择（$[Fe/H] \le -0.8$、$2\sigma$）下获得 970 个候选，估计完备度为 64–65%、纯度为 41–62%；在更严格选择（$[Fe/H] \le -1.0$、$3\sigma$）下获得 220 个候选，完备度降至 30–38%，但纯度提高到 60–91%。** 主要污染源具有异常光谱能量分布（如紫外超，UV excess），本身也是值得后续观测的目标。候选星在运动学与动力学性质上多样，**暗示其具有多种起源**。该可扩展的测光筛选方法可用于系统搜寻晕中的富氮星，并适用于 CSST 等未来宽视场巡天。
summary: Nitrogen-rich (N-rich) field stars (likely second-generation escapees from globular clusters) provide a powerful, but currently sample-limited, probe of globular-cluster disruption in the Galactic halo. We exploit the fact that enhanced NH, CN absorption depresses optical u band flux, while the near-ultraviolet (NUV) band is largely insensitive to nitrogen enhancement while remaining sensitive to overall metallicity. Combining GALEX NUV photometry with (synthetic) SDSS optical photometry, we construct a [Fe/H]-dependent stellar-locus model for giants and select significant redder u-g outliers as N-rich candidates. For a relaxed cut ([Fe/H] <= -0.8, 2 sigma) we identify 970 candidates, with an estimated completeness of 64-65% and purity of 41-62% from multiple validations. A stricter selection ([Fe/H] <= -1.0, 3 sigma) yields 220 candidates, with lower completeness (30-38%) but substantially higher purity (60-91%). The dominant contaminants show anomalous spectral energy distributions (e.g., UV excess), and are themselves useful targets for follow-up. The diverse kinematic and dynamical properties of our candidates suggest multiple origins. This scalable photometric approach enables systematic searches for N-rich halo stars and is well suited to forthcoming wide-field surveys such as CSST.

title: Gravitational Waves from New Inflation
background_knowledge: 宇宙暴胀是极早期宇宙经历的一次近指数加速膨胀，它可解释宇宙的大尺度均匀性、平直性以及原初扰动谱的起源。暴胀通常由标量场（暴胀子）驱动，其缓慢滚动由势能 $V(\phi)$ 的平坦程度控制。暴胀期间的量子涨落会被拉伸到超视界尺度，形成曲率扰动和张量扰动；后者传播至今即为原初引力波，其振幅常以张量-标量比 $r$ 刻画。不同暴胀模型在势能形状、场 excursion 大小以及暴胀后 reheating 动力学上差异显著，因此引力波是区分模型的重要探针。new inflation 是 small-field inflation 的典型实现：暴胀子场 excursion 远小于 Planck 质量，势能存在平坦区域，CMB 尺度上的张量信号通常较弱。除原初真空涨落外，暴胀后阶段（如 reheating、preheating、场振荡与共振等）的经典和量子过程也可产生随机引力波背景，尤其可在高频段留下丰富信息。该领域的研究范式包括构建暴胀模型、求解扰动模方程与源项、计算引力波谱，并与 CMB 及高频引力波探测方案进行比较。
contribution: 论文针对 new inflation 这一 small-field inflation 的典型实现，给出首个完整的引力波谱预测。作者纳入所有已知的引力波产生机制，同时考虑经典源与量子源，系统刻画该场景下的完整引力波信号。**核心结论是：首次给出 new inflation 场景下包含经典与量子产生机制的完整引力波谱预测**，从而为利用高频引力波信息限制暴胀子性质与暴胀后动力学、并区分不同暴胀模型提供基础。
summary: Gravitational waves provide one of the most powerful observational probes for discriminating among inflationary models. In particular, it has recently become clear that the high-frequency gravitational-wave spectrum encodes a wealth of information about the properties of the inflaton and the post-inflationary dynamics. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive prediction of the complete gravitational-wave spectrum in the new inflation scenario, a prototypical realization of small-field inflation, incorporating all known production mechanisms including both the classical and quantum sources.

title: Testing Dynamical Dark-Energy Model with Standard Sirens
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学把宇宙膨胀历史编码在哈勃参数 $H(z)$ 和距离—红移关系中，并用 $\Lambda$CDM 模型描述暗能量为宇宙学常数（$w=-1$）。动力学暗能量允许状态方程 $w(z)$ 随时间演化，是检验基本物理和解释 DESI 等巡天潜在偏离的关键方向。标准汽笛来自引力波源的波形分析：致密双星并合可直接给出光度距离，若通过宿主星系等手段确定红移，就能独立测量距离—红移关系，不受传统距离阶梯和尘埃消光影响，因而与超新星、BAO、CMB 等互补。爱因斯坦望远镜（Einstein Telescope，ET）预期探测大量双中子星并合，其中明亮标准汽笛有可辨识的宿主红移，可用于重建 $w(z)$。研究范式通常包括：构建模拟星表、加入测量误差和选择效应、联合多探针做参数推断，并用信息量、模式数或模型比较评估对 $\Lambda$CDM 的检验能力。
contribution: 论文以 DESI DR2 给出的 29 个分箱暗能量状态方程最佳拟合作为基准宇宙学，生成 100、500、1000 和 3000 个具有已知宿主红移的双中子星标准汽笛模拟星表，并分别利用仅引力波数据和引力波联合 DESI DR2 BAO、BBN 以及压缩 CMB 约束来重建 $w(z)$。结果显示，有效约束模式数为 $N_{\mathrm{eff}}\sim 4-5$（仅引力波）和 $5-6$（联合），信息集中在少数相关模式中。**3000 个引力波事件的标准汽笛星表可使对 $\Lambda$CDM 的偏离超过 $5\sigma$，联合分析在 $O(10^3)$ 事件量级也可达到相近显著性。** 仅用引力波数据比较平坦 $\Lambda$CDM 与其 Chevallier-Polarski-Linder 扩展时，1000 和 3000 个事件分别给出 $3.3\sigma$ 和 $6.3\sigma$ 的显著性；加入外部数据后升至 $7.7\sigma$ 和 $11.0\sigma$。**因此，数千个 ET 明亮标准汽笛有望对偏离 $\Lambda$CDM 的动力学暗能量提供灵敏检验。**
summary: Bright standard sirens from the Einstein Telescope (ET) provide an independent probe of cosmic expansion. In this article, we test whether future ET observations can constrain a dynamical dark-energy scenario inspired by DESI DR2. Using the best-fitting 29-bin dark-energy equation of state as the fiducial cosmology, we generate mock catalogs of 100, 500, 1000, and 3000 binary-neutron-star standard sirens with known host redshifts, and reconstruct the equation of state using both GW-only data and combined analyses with DESI DR2 BAO, BBN, and a compressed CMB constraint. The effective numbers of constrained modes are $N_{\mathrm{eff}}\sim 4-5$ (GW-only) and $5-6$ (combined), with information concentrated in a few correlated modes. The GW3000 catalog yields a departure from $Λ$CDM exceeding $5σ$, and combined analyses reach similar significance for $O(10^3)$ events. Comparing flat $Λ$CDM with its Chevallier-Polarski-Linder extension using GW data alone gives significances of $3.3σ$ and $6.3σ$ for 1000 and 3000 events, rising to $7.7σ$ and $11.0σ$ with external data. These results indicate that a few thousand ET bright standard sirens could provide a sensitive test of departures from $Λ$CDM.

title: Lasting mEMRIs: Signatures of Multiple Black Hole Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals from AGN discs
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由中心超大质量黑洞（SMBH）吸积周围气体形成明亮盘状结构。盘中的恒星质量黑洞（sBH）会与气体、其他恒星和黑洞发生动力学相互作用，并被捕获到盘内迁移、聚集，甚至形成成对或成团系统。当 sBH 靠近中心 SMBH 时，引力波（GW）辐射逐渐主导轨道演化，可形成极端质量比旋进（EMRI），其波形携带小质量天体质量、自旋以及强引力场时空结构的信息，是 LISA 等毫赫兹引力波天文台的重要探测目标。平运动共振（MMR）是指两个天体轨道周期呈简单整数比；在 AGN 盘环境中，sBH 对可通过气体扭矩与引力相互作用被锁定在共振状态并共同迁移。若共振对在近距离仍保持完整，两个 EMRI 会几乎同时辐射引力波，形成多极端质量比旋进（mEMRI），其波形包含轨道会合带来的额外谐波，并可能造成与孤立 EMRI 的参数简并，因此需要专门的波形建模与数据分析方法。
contribution: 论文推导出一个仅依赖 sBH 质量比与共振阶的简单判据，用于判断一对处于平运动共振的 sBH 在靠近中心 SMBH、引力波辐射超过气体扭矩时能否保持完整，并作为 LISA 可探测的 mEMRI。作者**首次给出共迁移、处于平运动共振的 sBH 对的引力波应变特征**，包括由两个 EMRI 轨道会合产生的额外引力波谐波。其频率演化与对应的啁啾质量（chirp mass）可与不同质量的孤立 EMRI 简并；**mEMRI 的质量比被共振阶量子化，且大于真实质量比**。若能从单个应变振幅推断真实 sBH 质量比，则可破除该简并。作者认为，**若盘驱动 EMRI 能被 LISA 探测，mEMRI 应当常见**，在局域宇宙（红移 $z \lesssim 0.2$）中约为每年 $\sim 10$ 个，凸显未来 LISA 数据分析中建模 mEMRI 系统的必要性。
summary: Encounters of stellar-mass black holes (sBH) in active galactic nuclei discs naturally form mean-motion resonances of sBH pairs. These mean-motion resonances can be broken close to the central supermassive black hole when gravitational-wave emission dominates over gas torques. We derive a simple condition that depends only on the sBH mass ratio and the resonance index for which a pair of sBH in a mean-motion resonance will remain intact and can be detectable as a multiple Extreme-Mass-Ratio-Inspirals (mEMRIs) in the LISA band. We present for the first time the gravitational-wave strain signatures of a pair of co-migrating sBH in mean-motion resonance, including additional gravitational-wave harmonics associated with orbital conjunctions of the individual EMRIs. The frequency evolution and the associated chirp mass is degenerate with isolated EMRIs of different masses. However, the mEMRI mass ratio is quantised by the resonance order and is larger than the true mass ratio. The degeneracy can be broken if the true sBH mass ratio can be inferred from individual strain amplitudes. We argue that mEMRIs should be common if disc driven EMRIs are to be detected by LISA, with $\sim 10$ mEMRIs per year in the local universe ($z \lesssim 0.2$), highlighting the need to model mEMRI systems in future LISA data analysis.

title: Gravothermal Evolution of Self-Interacting Dark Matter Halos across Knudsen Numbers
background_knowledge: 在标准宇宙学中，冷暗物质（CDM）近似无碰撞，主要依靠引力成团，并在小尺度上形成密度尖峰。CDM 在星系尺度面临若干争议，例如低质量晕的核心—尖峰问题、卫星星系过密问题等，这推动了对暗物质自相互作用（SIDM）的研究。SIDM 的基本物理图像是暗物质粒子之间存在弹性散射：散射重新分配能量和动量，在晕中心高密度区产生热传导，使初始尖峰变平，并在足够长时间后触发引力热灾变与核坍缩。散射效率不只由截面大小决定，还取决于平均自由程相对系统尺度的大小，常用 Knudsen 数 $\mathrm{Kn}$ 描述：当 $\mathrm{Kn} \gg 1$ 时碰撞稀少，体系接近无碰撞；当 $\mathrm{Kn} \ll 1$ 时局部热平衡成立，可用流体与热传导方程描述；中间区域必须借助动理学模拟。若相互作用由轻媒介子传递，截面可强烈依赖相对速度，例如在相对速度高于某速度尺度 $w$ 时 $\sigma \propto v^{-4}$，从而使低质量、低速度弥散晕中的有效截面显著增强。该领域通常结合理想化模拟、宇宙学模拟中的晕抽取、流体近似和动理学计算，研究核心形成、热演化、坍缩时间及密度剖面。
contribution: 论文研究通过轻媒介子发生弹性自相互作用的暗物质：在相对速度高于粒子物理参数给出的速度尺度 $w$ 时，截面满足 $\sigma \propto v^{-4}$，因此低质量晕中的有效截面可能远大于此前广泛研究的范围。作者使用 KiSS-SIDM 对孤立 SIDM 晕开展动理学模拟，系统扫描晕质量、浓度与截面，截面范围从 $50\,\mathrm{cm}^2\,\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ 到 $250{,}000\,\mathrm{cm}^2\,\mathrm{g}^{-1}$，并纳入多种速度依赖截面以及完全微分（各向异性）截面。主要结论为：**对理想 NFW 晕，坍缩时间可由尺度半径处的 Knudsen 数预测**；对于从宇宙学模拟中抽取、分别采用 $N$-body（无碰撞）或 SPH（强碰撞）动力学的晕，再用 KiSS-SIDM 演化其切出区域，所得坍缩时间相对理想 NFW 结果最多相差数倍。作者还用两点打靶法求解结构方程的边界值问题，校准了一个流体静力学模型；**该流体模型预测，在速度无关截面情形下，晕在坍缩晚期会形成对流区**。**动理学模拟与流体程序的坍缩时间总体吻合良好，尤其在速度无关截面情形；密度剖面在部分情形也吻合良好，其中包括所有速度依赖截面的运行**。
summary: If the dark matter self-interacts elastically via a light mediator, then at relative velocities above a scale $w$ dictated by particle physics parameters, the cross section scales as $σ\propto v^{-4}$.
