At LSST's imaging depths, light sources often overlap visually, so the configuration of sources in each image is itself uncertain. Nevertheless, LSST's cataloging pipeline commits to a single source configuration, which can bias downstream analyses.
  Here, we instead approximate a posterior distribution over source configurations. Our posterior approximation is a continuous-time Markov process (CTMP) fitted by generator matching, an extension of flow matching to non-Euclidean state spaces. This CTMP generates a source configuration in two phases: it detects light sources in the first and measures them in the second. On simulated LSST-like data, the proposed method produces better posterior approximations than five comparison methods: two Markov chain Monte Carlo methods that run thousands of times more slowly at survey scales; two neural posterior estimation methods; and one ablation of the proposed method that lacks the dual-phase structure. Applied to LSST Data Preview 1 (DP1), the first public release of Rubin imaging, the proposed method alone recovers small-scale galaxy clustering in agreement with higher-resolution Hubble imaging and reports uncertainty that remains calibrated against that reference as blending increases. We deliver a probabilistic catalog of the Extended Chandra Deep Field South region, one of the most extensively studied extragalactic fields, and use it to characterize the galaxy color-magnitude distribution.

title: FAUST XXXII. Chemically layered structures and ionisation in the disk and envelope of NGC 1333 IRAS 4C
background_knowledge: 低质量恒星形成始于分子云核的引力坍缩，期间形成原恒星、吸积盘、包层与外流。按演化阶段常分为 Class 0、Class I、Class II 等：Class 0 原恒星仍深埋于富气体包层中，吸积强烈，盘与包层难以在空间上清晰区分；后续阶段包层逐渐消散，年轻星盘变得更易观测。原恒星盘不是化学均匀的：盘中层密度高、屏蔽强，易发生分子冻结与复杂化学；盘上层受中心星紫外/X 射线及外场辐照，可产生光化学产物。因此，不同分子可作为气体密度、温度、辐照或电离状态的示踪剂，沿盘高度形成“垂直化学分层”，并可能沿盘半径变化。电离度与电离率控制磁转动不稳定性、磁流体动力学过程及盘演化，常通过 HCO+、H13CO+ 与 CO、C18O 等分子的柱密度比间接约束。高空间分辨率分子谱线观测，尤其是 ALMA 观测，是研究这些结构的主要手段；但在 Class 0 盘—包层系统中，此类化学分层目前仅在前景倾斜、空间可分辨的少数天体中得到了较详细研究。
contribution: 在 ALMA 大项目 FAUST 框架下，作者对 Perseus 分子云中低质量 Class 0 原恒星 NGC 1333 IRAS 4C 周围的盘与包层开展了分子谱线观测。该天体盘旋转轴与视线方向夹角很大，适合研究分子丰度随盘高度的分布。观测表明，C18O、H2CO 等气体密度示踪分子主要分布于盘中层附近；CCH、c-C3H2 等光化学示踪分子则出现在盘的低密度上层，**这一分层图像与 L1527 中的结果不同**。此外，由 H13CO+ 与 C18O 谱线得到的 HCO+/CO 柱密度比显示，**电离度与电离率随盘半径变化，并在盘外侧及包层中更高**。
summary: Recent molecular line observations with high spatial resolutions have revealed vertical chemical stratification in Class I/II disks (i.e. chemical composition changing with height in the vertical direction of the disk), as well as a radial variation of ionisation rates. However, such chemical layered structures in Class 0 disk and envelope systems have been investigated only for limited objects, such as L1527. In the context of the ALMA Large Program FAUST, we report the results of molecular line observations toward the disk and envelope around the low-mass Class 0 protostar NGC 1333 IRAS 4C in the Perseus Molecular Cloud. Previous observations have shown that the disk rotation axis of this object is largely tilted to the line of sight, making it suitable for studying the molecular abundance distribution as a function of disk height. We found that the molecules known as gas density tracers such as C18O and H2CO are distributed around the disk midplane. In addition, molecules known as tracers of photochemical reactions such as CCH and c-C3H2 are distributed in the low-density upper layers of the disk, unlike the distribution in L1527. Moreover, the column density ratio of HCO+/CO derived from the H13CO+ and C18O line emission suggests that the ionisation degree and the ionisation rate vary with the disk radius and they are larger in the outer region of the disk and envelope.

title: The Balmer Absorber Strength Problem of Little Red Dots
background_knowledge: Little Red Dots（LRDs）是 JWST 发现的一类高红移、致密且偏红的天体，其光谱常出现宽 Balmer 线及 Balmer 吸收，是理解早期黑洞增长、AGN 活动与周围气体环境的重要窗口。Balmer 吸收来自氢原子从 $n=2$ 到更高能级的跃迁：${\rm H}\alpha$ 对应 $n=3\to2$，${\rm H}\beta$ 对应 $n=4\to2$。在传统的谱线衰减图像中，吸收体被视为位于背景光源前方的纯吸收层，观测到的吸收等值宽主要由吸收柱密度、振子强度和线宽决定；由于 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 的振子强度通常大于 ${\rm H}\beta$，相同条件下应预期更强的 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 吸收。然而真实吸收介质也会被中心源电离并发出辐射，其自身发射会部分填充吸收槽；当谱线光学厚时，辐射转移中的源函数不可忽略。LRDs 的 Balmer 吸收因此不仅是气体柱密度问题，也牵涉吸收体的电离结构、运动学及其相对中心引擎的位置。
contribution: 论文针对部分 LRD 光谱中 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 吸收弱于 ${\rm H}\beta$、与标准原子物理衰减模型存在表观矛盾的现象，指出标准模型忽略了吸收介质自身的发射。作者提出：当 Balmer 吸收光学厚时，不可忽略的源函数会填充 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 吸收槽，从而降低其观测等值宽（EW）。通过概念验证性光致电离模型，作者证明 **${\rm H}\alpha$ 的源函数可以系统性强于 ${\rm H}\beta$**：当介质对 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 光学厚、但对 Paschen-$\alpha$ 并不很厚时，辐射囚禁会优先布居中性氢的 $n=3$ 能级，形成线依赖的源函数。该效应可显著修正预期 EW，并 **选择性削弱 ${\rm H}\alpha$ 吸收，与观测趋势一致**。定量结果取决于吸收介质到中心源的距离及其内部结构，因而为探测 LRD 周围环境提供了新诊断；未来对吸收体的建模还可能 **为估计中心引擎质量开辟新途径**。
summary: Little Red Dots (LRDs) commonly show Balmer absorption features. Some observed LRD spectra have weaker absorption in H$α$ than in H$β$, in apparent contradiction to atomic physics according to standard attenuation models. This tension is naturally resolved when one considers emission from the absorbing medium itself, which is ignored in the standard model: when the Balmer absorption is optically thick, a non-negligible source function could fill in the H$α$ absorption trough and reduce its observed absorption equivalent width (EW). With proof-of-concept photoionization models we show that the source function of H$α$ could be systematically stronger than that of H$β$. This is due to radiative trapping preferentially populating the $n=3$ level of neutral hydrogen, which operates efficiently when the medium is optically thick to H$α$ but not very optically thick to Paschen-$α$. Such line-dependent source functions could lead to significant corrections to the expected EW and selectively weaken H$α$ absorption, consistent with observations. Quantitatively, this depends on the distance of the absorbing medium and its internal structure, providing a new diagnostic of the environment around LRDs. Future modeling of the absorbers may also potentially open a new avenue for estimating the mass of the central engine.

title: NGC 3227 Blinks: An Extreme Changing-Look Event in a Seyfert Galaxy
background_knowledge:
活动星系核（AGN）由超大质量黑洞吸积供能，其标准图像包括产生光学/紫外连续谱的吸积盘、被中心辐射电离并产生宽发射线的宽线区（BLR），以及更外围的尘埃环或气体库。Seyfert 星系是邻近宇宙中常见的一类 AGN。Changing-look AGN 指观测到的光谱型在时间上发生显著改变，典型表现为宽发射线出现或消失、连续谱大幅变化；其物理原因可能包括吸积率变化与视线方向遮挡变化，二者需借助多波段监测、混响映射和光致电离模型区分。
\n混响映射利用连续谱变化后宽线响应的时延测量 BLR 的尺度和结构；若连续谱被位于 BLR 内侧的遮挡体削弱，而 BLR 仍对中心辐射作出响应，则可出现连续谱变暗但宽线时延仍保留的观测特征。X 射线谱硬化常被用于诊断视线方向的中性气体或电离气体吸收，而 Compton-thick 指柱密度高到电子散射和吸收显著影响 X 射线与光学/紫外辐射的介质。
\n该领域的研究范式通常是把长期或高频测光、同时或准同时 X 射线观测、光谱监测与物理模型结合，以判断 changing-look 现象是由本征辐射变化还是由尘埃或气体遮挡造成。
contribution:
论文报告 Seyfert 星系 NGC 3227 中一次快速光学 changing-look 事件：光学连续谱在数周内衰减超过 70%，宽 H$\beta$ 发射线几乎消失，随后在两个月内恢复。基于该源正常光变标定的 damped random walk（DRW）模拟表明，这种下降难以由随机吸积涨落解释（$p = 0.002$）。Swift 同时监测显示 X 射线谱变硬，指示视线方向吸收增强。
\n在暗态期间，混响映射仍测得连续谱与宽 H$\beta$ 线之间持续 $6$–$8$ 天的滞后，说明宽线区仍在回响，并将遮挡体定位在宽线区内侧。光致电离计算要求一个完全电离、Compton-thick 的柱密度 $N_{\rm H} \sim 1.5 \times 10^{24}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-2}$ 才能重现光学连续谱的压低。**这些结果共同表明，宽线区内侧的致密、高柱密度遮挡体能够在周尺度上产生极端光学 changing-look 行为。**
summary: We report a rapid optical changing-look event in the Seyfert galaxy NGC 3227: the optical continuum faded by more than 70% and broad H-beta emission nearly disappeared within weeks, before recovering within two months. Damped random walk simulations calibrated to the source's normal variability show that such a decline is unlikely for stochastic accretion fluctuations (p = 0.002). Simultaneous Swift monitoring reveals X-ray spectral hardening, pointing to enhanced line-of-sight absorption. During the dim state, reverberation mapping yields a persistent 6-8 day lag between the continuum and broad H-beta, showing that the broad-line region continued to reverberate and placing the obscurer interior to the broad-line region. Photoionization calculations require a fully ionized, Compton-thick column with N_H ~ 1.5 x 10^24 cm^-2 to reproduce the optical continuum suppression. Together, these observations demonstrate that compact, high-column-density obscurers interior to the broad-line region can produce extreme optical changing-look behavior on week timescales.

title: Data-driven characterisation of variable source light curves with multimodal representation learning
background_knowledge: 时域天文学通过重复观测获得天体亮度随时间变化的光变曲线，其形态由脉动、自转、双星掩食、爆发或吸积等物理过程共同决定，对应脉动变星、旋转变星、食双星和爆发型变源等类别。传统变源分类通常依赖振幅、周期、对称性、占空比等人工设计特征，并用有标签样本训练监督分类器。ZTF 与 LSST 等巡天以不规则采样、多波段、低信噪比的方式产生海量光变曲线，使该范式受限于标签成本、预定义分类体系与巡天间域偏移，难以跨巡天泛化。自监督表征学习试图在无标签条件下把光变曲线映射到低维嵌入，使物理性质相近的源在嵌入空间中靠近，并可用线性分类器评估表征质量。周期图（如广义 Lomb–Scargle）用于提取周期性；Transformer 可处理原始时序；多模态学习通过互补视图提升表征；VICReg 通过方差、不变性与协方差正则避免表征塌缩并保留各维信息。
contribution: 论文提出一个**无需标签、与巡天无关**的变源表征框架，将光变曲线的振幅、周期性、不对称性等性质压缩为低维嵌入。模型采用多模态架构：一支用 Transformer 编码原始观测序列，另一支用 CNN 编码广义 Lomb–Scargle 周期图；每条光变曲线被随机分为前后两段作为独立视图，两支联合用 VICReg 训练，使嵌入对时间半段不变且各维保持信息量。作者在 37 006 个 ZTF 源、14 个变星类别和 4 个宽泛物理类别上评估：冻结的 64 维嵌入上线性分类器达到 **77.1% 的类别平衡准确率**和 **90.5% 的宽类别平衡准确率**；融合双分支较最佳单模态最高提升 **14.9 个百分点**，证实互补性。可解释的光变属性被编码在不同维度，类内分析揭示参考标签未分辨的物理子结构。无修改地在 ZTF $g$ 和 $i$ 波段重训练可复现主要结果，拼接多波段嵌入将平衡准确率提升至 **86.1%**。框架不需要标签、相位折叠或巡天专属预处理，可直接用于不同采样与波长覆盖的其他巡天。
summary: Surveys such as the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) and the Vera C. Rubin Observatory Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) produce light curves for hundreds of millions of variables. Their characterisation traditionally relies on supervised classifiers with hand-crafted features and curated labels, limiting them to predefined taxonomies and individual surveys. We present a general, survey-agnostic framework that characterises variable sources without labelled training data, producing low-dimensional representations of light curve properties such as amplitude, periodicity, and asymmetry. A multimodal architecture combines two complementary views, a Transformer encoder on raw observations and a convolutional neural network on a generalised Lomb-Scargle periodogram. Each light curve is randomly split into two temporal halves as independent views, and the branches are trained jointly with VICReg to produce embeddings invariant across halves while keeping each dimension informative. We evaluate on 37 006 ZTF sources spanning 14 variable star classes in four broad physical categories. A linear classifier on the frozen 64-dimensional embeddings achieves 77.1% balanced accuracy for classes and 90.5% for broad categories. Combining both branches improves balanced accuracy by up to 14.9 percentage points over the best single modality, confirming their complementarity. Interpretable light curve properties are encoded on distinct dimensions, and within-class analysis reveals physical substructure unresolved by reference labels. Retraining on ZTF g and i bands without modification reproduces the main results, and concatenating multi-band embeddings improves balanced accuracy to 86.1%. The framework needs no labels, phase folding, or survey-specific preprocessing and applies directly to other surveys with different cadences and wavelength coverage.

title: Alleviating CMB-BAO tension with a large cosmic birefringence angle during reionization induced by energy injection to axion-like particles
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学以 $\Lambda$CDM 模型为基准，通过 CMB 温度与偏振各向异性、以及 BAO 等低红移探针联合限制宇宙学参数。CMB 偏振可分解为 $E$ 模与 $B$ 模；再电离时期产生的大尺度 $E$ 模偏振对 CMB 光深 $\tau$ 十分敏感，而 $\tau$ 又影响 CMB 声峰振幅与阻尼尾的推断，因此它与 BAO 给出的距离尺度测量之间存在参数匹配问题。宇宙双折射是指线偏振面在传播过程中发生旋转，可由轴子类粒子（ALPs）等与电磁场发生宇称破缺耦合的轻标量场引起；若旋转角在再电离时期显著大于复合时期，则会改变 $E$/$B$ 模分解并压低再电离的 $EE$ 信号，从而允许更高的 $\tau$。ALPs 的能量注入或场演化可使双折射角具有明显的宇宙学时间依赖，为同时解释 CMB 偏振异常与 CMB-BAO 张力提供物理机制。
contribution: 本文针对 DESI BAO 测量与 CMB 观测在标准 $\Lambda$CDM 模型下显现的轻度张力，以及 Planck 偏振数据中可能存在的宇宙双折射迹象，探索了一类由 ALPs 引起的、在再电离时期远大于复合时期的宇宙双折射场景。论文考虑在再电离之前发生从物质到 ALPs 的能量转移，并利用 Planck 低 $\ell$ 的 $EE$、$BB$ 与 $EB$ 数据检验该模型。结果表明，**对于 $10 \lesssim z \lesssim 100$ 的能量注入，存在参数区域可使 $\tau \simeq 0.08-0.10$ 与数据相容**；其中再电离时期的大旋转角压低 $EE$ 再电离信号，从而允许更高的 $\tau$，并缓解 CMB-BAO 张力。
summary: The recent measurement of baryon acoustic oscillations by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument reveals a mild tension with observations of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) within the standard $Λ$CDM cosmological model. Another interesting hint beyond standard cosmology arises from recent analyses of Planck polarization data which has been interpreted as cosmic birefringence. One possible solution to explain both observations is to introduce cosmic birefringence induced by axion-like particles (ALPs) that has a much larger rotation angle during the reionization epoch than that during the recombination: the large rotation suppresses the $EE$ reionization signal, allowing an elevated value of the CMB optical depth $τ$ that alleviates the CMB-BAO tension. In this paper, we explore a scenario where the energy transfers from matter to ALPs before the reionization. Using Planck low-$\ell$ $EE$, $BB$, and $EB$ data, we show that, for energy injection at $10 \lesssim z \lesssim 100$, there exist parameter regions where $τ\simeq 0.08-0.10$ is compatible with the data.

title: Optimal galaxy magnification: generalized fundamental-plane residuals and number counts are all you need
background_knowledge: 弱引力透镜是背景星系光线经过前景大尺度结构时发生的轻微偏折。其一阶效应由收敛场 $\kappa$ 描述：$\kappa$ 使星系图像整体缩放，从而同时改变星系流量、视大小以及给定流量极限以上的星系计数；形状改变则对应宇宙剪切。宇宙剪切已成为宇宙学主力探针，而放大率（magnification）提供互补信息：流量被放大后可让更暗星系进入样本，但同一天区面积也被放大而导致数密度稀释，最终表现为随星系累积数密度斜率变化的计数偏差。传统放大率测量利用流量、大小或 number counts，但星系本征大小、表面亮度、形态和光度分布存在较大弥散，且高维星系性质分布难以精确建模，因此需要寻找既能压缩数据又尽量不损失信息的统计量。星系基本平面（fundamental plane）是早型星系大小、表面亮度与速度弥散之间的经验关系；广义基本平面（generalized fundamental plane, GFP）把更多透镜不变量纳入，以预测星系大小或流量。若把 GFP 预测的残差作为放大率的观测量，并利用 Fisher 信息框架比较不同统计量的精度，就可以系统回答“哪些星系性质组合对放大率测量最优”。
contribution: 论文从星系性质出发推导弱引力透镜放大率的最优统计量，并证明该最优测量可分解为最优均值统计量与总星系计数两部分。最优均值统计量由广义基本平面（GFP）的残差分布 $F(i,\boldsymbol{X})$ 构造：函数 $F$ 以表面亮度 $i$ 及额外透镜不变量 $\boldsymbol{X}$ 预测星系大小或等价流量，且可取任意形式，只要能够降低本征弥散并提高放大率精度。对于高斯残差分布，最优均值统计量化为逆方差加权残差；当弥散恒定时，它简化为残差本身。该统计量与总星系计数结合后，在泊松统计下捕获全部放大率 Fisher 信息，达到与全似然分析相同的精度。**GFP 残差与星系计数因而构成星系巡天中弱透镜放大率测量的最优组合**；这一压缩方式简单且具有物理直观性，避免了对可能高维的星系性质分布建模，尤其在引入额外观测量以压低 GFP 弥散时更具优势。
summary: Weak-lensing magnification complements cosmic shear through its effects on galaxy fluxes, sizes, and number counts. We derive the optimal magnification statistics from galaxy properties and show that the optimal measurement can be decomposed into an optimal mean statistic and total number counts. The optimal mean statistic can be constructed from the residual distribution of a generalized fundamental plane (GFP), $F(i,\boldsymbol{X})$, which predicts galaxy size or, equivalently, flux from surface brightness $i$ and additional lensing-invariant properties $\boldsymbol{X}$. The function $F$ can take any form that reduces the intrinsic scatter and thereby improves magnification precision. For a Gaussian residual distribution, the optimal mean statistic reduces to the inverse-variance-weighted residual, or simply the residual for constant scatter. Together with total number counts, this statistic captures all the magnification Fisher information under Poisson statistics, achieving the same precision as a full-likelihood analysis. This provides a simple and physically intuitive optimal compression of the full magnification likelihood, avoiding the need to model the potentially high-dimensional galaxy-property distribution, particularly when additional observables are incorporated to reduce the GFP scatter. Our results demonstrate that GFP residuals and number counts provide an optimal combination for weak-lensing magnification measurements in galaxy surveys.

title: Poisson Clustering and Seed Effect of PBHs: Implications for Microlensing, Gravitational Waves, Little Red Dots and Ultra-Faint Dwarf Galaxies
background_knowledge: 现代宇宙学表明，暗物质约占宇宙能量密度的四分之一，是星系旋转曲线、星系团质量、宇宙微波背景以及大尺度结构形成等现象的关键组成。主流研究将暗物质视为尚未确认的基本粒子，并通过地下直接探测、对撞机实验和天文观测寻找其非引力相互作用；但至今没有决定性信号，这促使人们重新审视原初黑洞（primordial black holes, PBHs）等宏观候选体。原初黑洞可在极早期宇宙由原初密度扰动坍缩形成，其质量可覆盖很宽范围；质量约太阳量级的原初黑洞尤其重要，因为它们可通过微引力透镜、双黑洞并合引力波以及小尺度结构效应被检验。若原初黑洞构成暗物质，它们不是连续流体，而是离散质量点，其泊松密度涨落会在小尺度上早于普通暗物质形成结构；较大质量“种子”黑洞还可通过引力吸引周围黑洞，形成束缚团簇。理解这类团簇的形成、动力学加热、潮汐剥离与并合，是连接原初黑洞暗物质与微引力透镜、引力波、超暗弱矮星系（Ultra-Faint Dwarf Galaxies, UFDs）和高红移小红点（Little Red Dots, LRDs）等观测的核心研究范式。
contribution:
论文针对扩展的原初黑洞质量函数，综合考察泊松涨落与种子涨落导致的引力束缚、动力学加热对团簇的稀释，以及银河系晕不同区域中的潮汐瓦解和碰撞，系统评估其对暗物质占比限制和多种天体现象的影响。作者指出，这种质量函数会自然产生质量中等的暗的维里化束缚黑洞团簇，并在中心存在质量更大的黑洞。**小于约 $10^{6}\,M_{\odot}$ 的团簇会被动力学加热有效稀释**；团簇可在银河系晕外部（如朝麦哲伦云方向）存活，但在中心晕区会因潮汐瓦解和碰撞而被破坏。
\n在此基础上，作者重新审视微引力透镜和引力波限制。**具有预期质量和半径的原初黑洞团簇不太可能放宽微引力透镜限制**；不过，**银河系旋转曲线的下降可能放宽该限制，使相当一部分暗物质由在量子色动力学（QCD）相变时期形成的太阳质量原初黑洞组成**。他们还强调双黑洞并合率必须修正：**在原初黑洞团簇中形成的双黑洞系统可主导并合率，并在原初黑洞构成暗物质时可能与 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA（LVK）引力波限制相容**。更积极的是，**超暗弱矮星系和小红点可能由种子效应与泊松效应的组合产生**。最后，若原初扰动具有指数型非高斯尾部，团簇会强于泊松预言，从而改变上述结论，并为太阳质量原初黑洞解释暗物质开辟新可能。
summary: The existence of primordial black holes (PBHs) could have significant effects on the formation of cosmic structures through both the seed effect and the Poisson effect. For an extended PBH mass function, this should lead to dark virialised bound clusters of black holes with modest mass, together with central black holes of larger mass. We consider the combination of three effects: the inevitable gravitational binding of small-scale inhomogeneities due to Poisson and seed fluctuations; the dilution through dynamical heating of all clusters smaller than around $10^{6}\,M_{\odot}$; the survival of clusters in the outer Galactic halo (i.e. towards the Magellanic Clouds) but their destruction in the central halo region through tidal disruption and collisions. We examine the implications of this for the constraints on the fraction of dark matter in PBHs from microlensing surveys and gravitational-wave events. Although the clustering of PBHs with the expected mass and radius is unlikely to relax the microlensing limits, the decline of the Galactic rotation curve might do so, allowing much of the dark matter to be in solar-mass PBHs formed at the quantum chromodynamics transition. We also emphasise that binary merger rates must be revised: binaries formed in PBH clusters can dominate the merger rate, which may be compatible with the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA gravitational-wave limits if PBHs provide the dark matter. More positively, Ultra-Faint Dwarf Galaxies and Little Red Dots might arise through a combination of the seed and Poisson effects. Our conclusions could be modified for PBHs produced from primordial fluctuations with exponential non-Gaussian tails, since the clustering would then exceed the Poissonian prediction, opening up new possibilities to explain dark matter with solar-mass PBHs.
